meta.milestone: 卡池扩容：由清洗数据集 + K2 解析链生成扩展卡池
meta.admission: 严格准入：仅收录「所有解析条目均已映射到引擎可执行 tag」的卡；任一处未建模即整卡不收（避免部分效果静默丢失）。无解析产物的卡仅收纯伤害宝可梦与基本能量。
meta.precedence: 人工卡池 cards_real.json 优先（**按印刷 set+number**：同名不同印刷可以共存放行）；条目带 `uid`（`<卡名>@<SET> <number>`）用于跨印刷寻址
meta.honesty: 本池条目为**规则解析链推导**（非人工逐卡校对），装载侧标记为 engine_status=approximated；卡面数值来自清洗数据集，效果保真度取决于解析链召回率，差异见未建模动作清单

cards.name: Neo Upper Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

If this card is attached to a Stage 2 Pokémon, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 2 Energy at a time.
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

若此卡附着于 2 阶进化宝可梦，则此卡提供所有属性的能量，但一次只提供 2 个能量。

cards.name: Mist Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent’s Pokémon done to the Pokémon this card is attached to. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

防止对手的宝可梦所使用招式对此卡附着的宝可梦造成的所有效果。（已有的效果不会被移除。伤害不是效果。）

cards.name: Legacy Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.

If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card. This effect of your Legacy Energy only works once per game.
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供所有属性的能量，但一次只提供 1 个能量。

若此卡附着的宝可梦因对手的宝可梦所用招式的伤害而被击倒，则该玩家少拿 1 张奖赏卡。你的「遗产能量」的这个效果每局只能生效 1 次。

cards.name: Enriching Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

When you attach this card from your hand to a Pokémon, draw 4 cards.
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

当你从手牌将此卡附着于宝可梦时，抽 4 张牌。

cards.name: Spiky Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 2 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

若此卡附着的宝可梦位于战斗区，且受到对手的宝可梦所用招式的伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），则在攻击的宝可梦上放置 2 个伤害指示物。

cards.name: Team Rocket's Energy
cards.desc:
This card can only be attached to a Team Rocket’s Pokémon. If this card is attached to anything other than a Team Rocket’s Pokémon, discard this card.

As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides 2 in any combination of {P} Energy and {D} Energy.
cards.desc_zh:
此卡只能附着于火箭队的宝可梦。若此卡附着于火箭队的宝可梦以外的对象，则弃置此卡。

只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 2 个能量，其属性为 {P} 能量与 {D} 能量的任意组合。

cards.name: Prism Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

If this card is attached to a Basic Pokémon, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

若此卡附着于基础宝可梦，则此卡提供所有属性的能量，但一次只提供 1 个能量。

cards.name: Ignition Energy
cards.desc:
If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your turn.

As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

If this card is attached to an Evolution Pokémon, it provides {C}{C}{C} Energy instead.
cards.desc_zh:
若此卡附着于你的 1 只宝可梦，则在你回合结束时弃置此卡。

只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

若此卡附着于进化宝可梦，则改为提供 {C}{C}{C} 能量。

cards.name: Grow Grass Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {G} Energy.
The {G} Pokémon this card is attached to gets +20 HP.
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {G} 能量。
此卡附着的 {G} 宝可梦的 HP +20。

cards.name: Telepath Psychic Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {P} Energy.
When you attach this card from your hand to a {P} Pokémon, search your deck for up to 2 Basic {P} Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {P} 能量。
当你从手牌将此卡附着于 {P} 宝可梦时，从牌库中检索至多 2 只基础 {P} 宝可梦并放置于后备。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Rock Fighting Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {F} Energy.
Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent’s Pokémon done to the {F} Pokémon this card is attached to. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {F} 能量。
防止对手的宝可梦所使用招式对此卡附着的 {F} 宝可梦造成的所有效果。（已有的效果不会被移除。伤害不是效果。）

attacks.name: Nab ’n’ Dash
attacks.desc: Search your deck for a number of cards up to the number of your Benched Pokémon and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索数量不超过你后备宝可梦数量的卡并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.desc: Switch out your opponent’s Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 将对手的战斗宝可梦换入后备。（由对手选择新的战斗宝可梦。）

attacks.name: Super Sandstorm
attacks.desc: This attack also does 40 damage to each Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it (both yours and your opponent’s). (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式还对身上放有伤害指示物的每只后备宝可梦（你的与对手的）造成 40 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Comet Punch
attacks.desc: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛 4 次硬币。此招式每出现 1 次正面就造成 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Wicked Impact
attacks.desc: If you played a Supporter card that has “Team Rocket” in its name from your hand during this turn, this attack does 100 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若你在本回合从手牌使用了名称中含有「火箭队」的支援者卡，则此招式的伤害 +100。

attacks.name: Slow Crunch
attacks.desc: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. At the end of your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon will be Knocked Out.
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置此宝可梦身上的所有能量。在对手的下个回合结束时，战斗宝可梦将被击倒。

attacks.name: Leaflet Blessings
attacks.desc: Attach a Basic {G} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, heal all damage from that Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从手牌中把 1 张基本 {G} 能量卡附着于你的 1 只后备宝可梦。若如此做，回复该宝可梦的所有伤害。

attacks.name: Recovery Net
attacks.desc: Put up to 2 Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 从弃牌堆中取至多 2 只宝可梦加入手牌。

attacks.name: Avenging Edge
attacks.desc: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent’s last turn, this attack does 60 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若你的任意宝可梦在对手的上个回合中因招式的伤害而被击倒，则此招式的伤害 +60。

abilities.name: Storehouse Hideaway
abilities.desc: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon done to this Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 只要此宝可梦位于后备，就防止对手的宝可梦所使用招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害与效果。

attacks.name: Re-Brew
attacks.desc: Put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon for each Basic {G} Energy card in your discard pile. Then, shuffle those Energy cards into your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 你的弃牌堆中每有 1 张基本 {G} 能量卡，就在对手的 1 只宝可梦上放置 2 个伤害指示物。然后将那些能量卡洗回牌库。

attacks.name: Matcha Splash
attacks.desc: Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 回复你的每只宝可梦的 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Hot Magma
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Burned.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦陷入灼伤。

attacks.name: Ground Burn
attacks.desc: Discard the top card of each player’s deck. This attack does 140 more damage for each Energy card discarded in this way.
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置每位玩家牌库顶的 1 张卡。以此方式弃置的每张能量卡使此招式的伤害 +140。

attacks.name: Allure
attacks.desc: Draw 2 cards.
attacks.desc_zh: 抽 2 张牌。

attacks.name: Ground Melter
attacks.desc: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 60 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium.
attacks.desc_zh: 若场上有竞技场卡，则此招式的伤害 +60。然后弃置那个竞技场。

attacks.name: Permeating Chill
attacks.desc: At the end of your opponent’s next turn, put 9 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合结束时，在战斗宝可梦上放置 9 个伤害指示物。

attacks.name: Flock
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Froakie and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索至多 2 只呱呱泡蛙并放置于后备。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Numbing Water
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，对手的战斗宝可梦陷入麻痹。

attacks.name: Pick and Stick
attacks.desc: Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.
attacks.desc_zh: 从弃牌堆中把至多 2 张基本能量卡以你喜欢的方式附着于你的宝可梦。

abilities.name: Snack Seek
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may look at the top card of your deck. You may discard that card.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次。查看你牌库顶的 1 张卡。你可以弃置那张卡。

attacks.name: Dual Headbutt
attacks.desc: This attack also does 10 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式还对你的 1 只后备宝可梦造成 10 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Love Resonance
attacks.desc: If any of your Pokémon in play are the same type as any of your opponent’s Pokémon in play, this attack does 120 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若你场上的任意宝可梦与对手场上的任意宝可梦属性相同，则此招式的伤害 +120。

attacks.name: Shinobi Blade
attacks.desc: You may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 你可以从牌库中检索 1 张卡并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Mirage Barrage
attacks.desc: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage to 2 of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置此宝可梦身上的 2 个能量。此招式对对手的 2 只宝可梦造成 120 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Ground Crasher
attacks.desc: If a Stadium is in play, this attack also does 30 damage to each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon, and discard that Stadium. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 若场上有竞技场卡，则此招式还对对手的每只后备宝可梦造成 30 点伤害，并弃置那个竞技场。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.desc: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.desc: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张从此宝可梦进化的卡并放置于此宝可梦上使其进化。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，此招式的伤害 +20。

attacks.name: Pinpoint Dive
attacks.desc: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon {ex} or Benched Pokémon {V}. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式对对手的 1 只后备宝可梦 ex 或后备宝可梦 V 造成 60 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Blaze Blitz
attacks.desc: This Pokémon can’t use Blaze Blitz again until it leaves the Active Spot.
attacks.desc_zh: 在此宝可梦离开战斗区之前，它无法再次使用「烈焰突袭」。

attacks.name: Big Bite
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon can’t retreat.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，战斗宝可梦无法撤退。

attacks.name: Reverse Thrust
attacks.desc: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 将此宝可梦与你的 1 只后备宝可梦互换。

attacks.name: Giant Wave
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use Giant Wave.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用「巨浪」。

abilities.name: Torrential Heart
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may put 5 damage counters on this Pokémon. If you do, during this turn, attacks used by this Pokémon do 120 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次。在此宝可梦上放置 5 个伤害指示物。若如此做，则在本回合中，此宝可梦使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦造成的伤害 +120（计算弱点和抗性之前）。

attacks.name: Lucky Find
attacks.desc: Search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张物品卡，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Aqua Bomb
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 20 点伤害。

attacks.name: Vanguard Punch
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself for each damage counter on it.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦身上的每个伤害指示物使此宝可梦还对自己造成 10 点伤害。

attacks.name: Double Hit
attacks.desc: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛 2 次硬币。此招式每出现 1 次正面就造成 90 点伤害。

attacks.name: Tricolor Pump
attacks.desc: Discard up to 3 Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon for each Energy card you discarded in this way. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 从手牌中弃置至多 3 张能量卡。以此方式弃置的每张能量卡使此招式对对手的 1 只宝可梦造成 60 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Numbing Hold
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon can’t retreat.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，战斗宝可梦无法撤退。

attacks.name: Ball Roll
attacks.desc: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
attacks.desc_zh: 反复抛硬币，直到出现反面。此招式每出现 1 次正面就造成 10 点伤害。

attacks.name: Mirror Attack
attacks.desc: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is a {P} Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦是 {P} 宝可梦，则此招式的伤害 +30。

attacks.name: Evolution Jammer
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, they can’t play any Pokémon from their hand to evolve their Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，对手不能从手牌使用任何宝可梦来进化其宝可梦。

attacks.name: Hex Hurl
attacks.desc: Put 2 damage counters on your opponent’s Benched Pokémon in any way you like.
attacks.desc_zh: 以你喜欢的方式在对手的后备宝可梦上放置 2 个伤害指示物。

abilities.name: Midnight Fluttering
abilities.desc: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent’s Active Pokémon has no Abilities, except for Midnight Fluttering.
abilities.desc_zh: 只要此宝可梦位于战斗区，对手的战斗宝可梦就没有特性，「午夜飘舞」除外。

abilities.name: Memory Dive
abilities.desc: Each of your evolved Pokémon can use any attack from its previous Evolutions. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)
abilities.desc_zh: 你的每只进化宝可梦都可以使用其先前进化形态的任意招式。（你仍然需要必要的能量来使用每个招式。）

attacks.name: Land Collapse
attacks.desc: Discard the top card of your opponent’s deck. If you played an Ancient Supporter card from your hand during this turn, discard 3 more cards in this way.
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置对手牌库顶的 1 张卡。若你在本回合从手牌使用了古代支援者卡，则再以此方式弃置 3 张卡。

attacks.name: Mysterious Beam
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，弃置对手的战斗宝可梦身上的 1 个能量。

attacks.name: Super Poison Breath
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦陷入中毒。

attacks.name: Vengeance Fletching
attacks.desc: This attack does 10 more damage for each Ancient card in your discard pile.
attacks.desc_zh: 你的弃牌堆中每有 1 张古代卡，此招式的伤害 +10。

attacks.name: Primordial Beatdown
attacks.desc: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Ancient Pokémon in play.
attacks.desc_zh: 你场上每有 1 只古代宝可梦，此招式造成 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.desc: This attack’s damage isn’t affected by any effects on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式的伤害不受对手的战斗宝可梦身上任何效果的影响。

attacks.name: Burst Roar
attacks.desc: Discard your hand and draw 6 cards.
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置你的手牌，然后抽 6 张牌。

attacks.name: Bellowing Thunder
attacks.desc: You may discard any amount of Basic Energy from your Pokémon. This attack does 70 damage for each card you discarded in this way.
attacks.desc_zh: 你可以弃置你的宝可梦身上任意数量的基本能量。以此方式弃置的每张卡使此招式造成 70 点伤害。

attacks.name: Rigidify
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，此宝可梦受到的招式伤害 -30（计算弱点和抗性之后）。

attacks.name: Comet Slap
attacks.desc: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛 3 次硬币。此招式每出现 1 次正面就造成 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Leaf Litter Tackle
attacks.desc: Discard a {G} Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置此宝可梦身上的 1 个 {G} 能量。

abilities.name: Changing Seasons
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Stadium card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次。从牌库中检索 1 张竞技场卡，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Slight Intrusion
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 10 点伤害。

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.desc: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦身上每附着 1 个能量，此招式的伤害 +30。

abilities.name: Spherical Shield
abilities.desc: Prevent all damage from and effects of attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon done to your Benched Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 防止对手的宝可梦所使用招式对你的后备宝可梦造成的所有伤害与效果。

attacks.name: Prism Edge
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用招式。

abilities.name: Rapid Vernier
abilities.desc: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon. If you do, you may move any amount of Energy from your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌将此宝可梦放置于后备时，你可以将此宝可梦与你的战斗宝可梦互换。若如此做，你可以将你的其他宝可梦身上任意数量的能量移动到这只宝可梦身上。

attacks.name: Roasting Heat
attacks.desc: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is Burned, this attack does 40 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦处于灼伤状态，则此招式的伤害 +40。

attacks.name: Fake Out
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，对手的战斗宝可梦陷入麻痹。

attacks.name: Flare Strike
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use Flare Strike.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用「烈焰打击」。

attacks.name: Blaze Blast
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Burned.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦陷入灼伤。

abilities.name: Hustle Play
abilities.desc: Attacks used by this Pokémon cost {C} less for each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 对手每有 1 只后备宝可梦，此宝可梦使用的招式所需能量就少 {C}。

attacks.name: Twin Shotels
attacks.desc: This attack does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent’s Pokémon. This attack’s damage isn’t affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on those Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式对对手的 2 只宝可梦造成 50 点伤害。此招式的伤害不受弱点和抗性，也不受那些宝可梦身上任何效果的影响。

abilities.name: Cobalt Command
abilities.desc: Attacks used by your Future Pokémon, except any Iron Crown {ex}, do 20 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
abilities.desc_zh: 你的未来宝可梦（任何「铁头壳 ex」除外）使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦造成的伤害 +20（计算弱点和抗性之前）。

abilities.name: Dig Dig Dig
abilities.desc: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Basic {F} Energy cards and discard them. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌将此宝可梦放置于后备时，你可以从牌库中检索至多 3 张基本 {F} 能量卡并弃置它们。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 50 点伤害。

attacks.name: Dirty Beam
attacks.desc: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式还对对手的 1 只后备宝可梦造成 30 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

abilities.name: Armor Tail
abilities.desc: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent’s Basic Pokémon {ex}.
abilities.desc_zh: 防止对手的基础宝可梦 ex 所用招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害。

attacks.name: Steel Wing
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, this Pokémon takes 50 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，此宝可梦受到的招式伤害 -50（计算弱点和抗性之后）。

attacks.name: Cross Breaker
attacks.desc: Discard up to 2 {M} Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage for each card you discarded in this way.
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置此宝可梦身上的至多 2 个 {M} 能量。以此方式弃置的每张卡使此招式造成 120 点伤害。

attacks.name: Iron Tackle
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 10 点伤害。

abilities.name: Metal Maker
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 4 cards of your deck and attach any number of Basic {M} Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards and put them on the bottom of your deck.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次。查看你牌库顶的 4 张卡，将其中你找到的任意数量的基本 {M} 能量卡以你喜欢的方式附着于你的宝可梦。将其余的卡洗牌后放置于你的牌库底。

attacks.name: Peak Acceleration
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Future Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索至多 2 张基本能量卡，并以你喜欢的方式将它们附着于你的未来宝可梦。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Quick Sign
attacks.desc: If you go first, you can use this attack during your first turn. Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 若你是先手玩家，你可以在你的第一个回合中使用此招式。从牌库中检索至多 2 张基础宝可梦并放置于后备。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Coordinated Strike
attacks.desc: If Illumise is on your Bench, this attack does 60 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若甜甜萤位于你的后备，则此招式的伤害 +60。

abilities.name: Boom Boom Groove
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, if your Active Pokémon has the Festival Lead Ability, you may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次。若你的战斗宝可梦拥有「庆典领舞」特性，则你可以从牌库中检索 1 张卡并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Drum Beating
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost {C} more, and its Retreat Cost is {C} more.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，战斗宝可梦使用的招式所需能量多 {C}，其撤退费用也多 {C}。

attacks.name: Wood Hammer
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 50 点伤害。

attacks.name: Tumbling Attack
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，此招式的伤害 +20。

attacks.name: Do the Wave
attacks.desc: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 你的后备宝可梦每有 1 只，此招式造成 20 点伤害。

abilities.name: Festival Lead
abilities.desc: If Festival Grounds is in play, this Pokémon may use an attack it has twice. If the first attack Knocks Out your opponent’s Active Pokémon, you may attack again after your opponent chooses a new Active Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 若场上有「庆典会场」，则此宝可梦可以使用其拥有的招式 2 次。若第一次招式击倒了对手的战斗宝可梦，则你可以在对手选择新的战斗宝可梦后再次攻击。

attacks.name: Mountain Stroll
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索至多 2 张基本能量卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Ogre Comeback
attacks.desc: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手每有 1 只后备宝可梦，此招式的伤害 +20。

attacks.name: Myriad Leaf Shower
attacks.desc: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to both Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 双方战斗宝可梦身上每附着 1 个能量，此招式的伤害 +30。

abilities.name: Teal Dance
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic {G} Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, draw a card.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次。从手牌中把 1 张基本 {G} 能量卡附着于此宝可梦。若你以此方式将能量附着于宝可梦，则抽 1 张牌。

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.desc: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只基础宝可梦并放置于后备。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Mind Ruler
attacks.desc: This attack does 30 damage for each card in your opponent’s hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手手牌中每有 1 张卡，此招式造成 30 点伤害。

abilities.name: Alluring Light
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may have each player draw a card.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次。让每位玩家各抽 1 张牌。

attacks.name: Wrathful Hearth
attacks.desc: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦身上每有 1 个伤害指示物，此招式造成 20 点伤害。

attacks.name: Dynamic Blaze
attacks.desc: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 140 more damage, and discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦是进化宝可梦，则此招式的伤害 +140，并弃置此宝可梦身上的所有能量。

attacks.name: Whirlpool
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，弃置对手的战斗宝可梦身上的 1 个能量。

abilities.name: Festival Lead
abilities.desc: If Festival Grounds is in play, this Pokémon may use an attack it has twice. If the first attack Knocks Out your opponent’s Active Pokémon, you may attack again after your opponent chooses a new Active Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 若场上有「庆典会场」，则此宝可梦可以使用其拥有的招式 2 次。若第一次招式击倒了对手的战斗宝可梦，则你可以在对手选择新的战斗宝可梦后再次攻击。

attacks.name: Inviting Kiss
attacks.desc: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. If you put any Pokémon onto your Bench in this way, move an Energy from this Pokémon to the new Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只基础宝可梦并放置于后备。然后洗牌。若你以此方式将宝可梦放置于后备，则将此宝可梦身上的 1 个能量移动到新放置的后备宝可梦上。

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.desc: Choose a random card from your opponent’s hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从对手手牌中随机选择 1 张卡。对手展示那张卡并将其洗回牌库。

abilities.name: Freezing Shroud
abilities.desc: During Pokémon Checkup, put 1 damage counter on each Pokémon that has an Ability (both yours and your opponent’s), except any Froslass.
abilities.desc_zh: 在宝可梦检查时，在拥有特性的每只宝可梦（你的与对手的）上放置 1 个伤害指示物，任何「雪妖女」除外。

attacks.name: Aqua Slash
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用招式。

abilities.name: Teleporter
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may shuffle it and all attached cards into your deck.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次。若此宝可梦位于战斗区，你可以将此宝可梦及所有附着卡洗回你的牌库。

attacks.name: Slurp Slurp
attacks.desc: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads. If both of them are tails, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Confused.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛 2 次硬币。此招式每出现 1 次正面就造成 90 点伤害。若 2 次都是反面，对手的战斗宝可梦陷入混乱。

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn’t happen.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，若战斗宝可梦试图使用招式，则由对手抛硬币。若为反面，则该招式不会发生。

attacks.name: Best Punch
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为反面，此招式无效。

attacks.name: Superpower
attacks.desc: You may do 30 more damage. If you do, this Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 你可以使伤害 +30。若这样做，此宝可梦也会受到 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Tantrum
attacks.desc: This Pokémon is now Confused.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦现在处于混乱状态。

attacks.name: Gutsy Swing
attacks.desc: If this Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, ignore all Energy in this attack’s cost.
attacks.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦处于特殊状态，则忽略此招式费用中的所有能量。

attacks.name: Demolish
attacks.desc: This attack’s damage isn’t affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式的伤害不受弱点、抗性以及对手战斗宝可梦身上任何效果的影响。

abilities.name: Cornerstone Stance
abilities.desc: Prevent all damage from attacks done to this Pokémon by your opponent’s Pokémon that have an Ability.
abilities.desc_zh: 防止对手拥有特性的宝可梦的招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害。

attacks.name: Steel Burst
attacks.desc: Discard all {M} Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置此宝可梦身上的所有 {M} 能量。此招式每有 1 张以此方式弃置的卡，就造成 50 点伤害。

abilities.name: Incandescent Body
abilities.desc: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Burned.
abilities.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦位于战斗区且受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），则使用招式的宝可梦现在处于灼伤状态。

abilities.name: Attract Customers
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may look at the top 6 cards of your deck, reveal a Supporter card you find there, and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，若此宝可梦位于战斗区，则你可以使用 1 次，查看自己牌库上方的 6 张卡，从中展示 1 张支援者卡并加入手牌。将其余的卡洗回牌库。

attacks.name: Mach Cut
attacks.desc: Discard a Special Energy from your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从对手的战斗宝可梦上弃置 1 个特殊能量。

abilities.name: Impromptu Carrier
abilities.desc: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for a Pokémon Tool card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌将此宝可梦放置到后备时，你可以从牌库中检索 1 张宝可梦道具卡并附着于此宝可梦。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Lucky Attachment
attacks.desc: Attach a Basic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从手牌中把 1 张基本能量卡附着于自己的 1 只宝可梦。

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用招式。

attacks.name: Return
attacks.desc: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 你可以抽牌，直到手牌有 6 张。

abilities.name: Happy Switch
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may move a Basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，将 1 个基本能量从自己的 1 只宝可梦移动到自己的另 1 只宝可梦上。

attacks.name: Shocking Web
attacks.desc: If this Pokémon has any {L} Energy attached, this attack does 80 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦附着了 {L} 能量，则此招式造成 +80 伤害。

abilities.name: Compound Eyes
abilities.desc: Attacks used by this Pokémon do 50 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon that has an Ability (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
abilities.desc_zh: 此宝可梦使用的招式对对手拥有特性的战斗宝可梦造成 +50 伤害（在应用弱点和抗性之前）。

attacks.name: Add On
attacks.desc: Draw a card.
attacks.desc_zh: 抽 1 张牌。

attacks.name: United Wings
attacks.desc: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the United Wings attack.
attacks.desc_zh: 自己弃牌堆中每有 1 只拥有联合之翼招式的宝可梦，此招式就造成 20 点伤害。

attacks.name: Stock Up on Feathers
attacks.desc: Draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 抽牌，直到手牌有 7 张。

attacks.name: Power Shot
attacks.desc: Discard a Basic {G} Energy card from your hand. If you can’t, this attack does nothing.
attacks.desc_zh: 从手牌中弃置 1 张基本 {G} 能量卡。若无法这样做，则此招式无效。

attacks.name: Come and Get You
attacks.desc: Put up to 3 Duskull from your discard pile onto your Bench.
attacks.desc_zh: 从弃牌堆中把最多 3 只夜巡灵放置到后备。

abilities.name: Cursed Blast
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may put 5 damage counters on 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon. If you use this Ability, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，在对手的 1 只宝可梦上放置 5 个伤害指示物。若你使用此特性，则此宝可梦被击倒。

attacks.name: Shadow Bind
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon can’t retreat.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，战斗宝可梦无法撤退。

abilities.name: Cursed Blast
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may put 13 damage counters on 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon. If you use this Ability, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，在对手的 1 只宝可梦上放置 13 个伤害指示物。若你使用此特性，则此宝可梦被击倒。

attacks.name: Mystical Return
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. Shuffle that Pokémon and all attached cards into their deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，选择对手的 1 只后备宝可梦。将那只宝可梦及其身上的所有卡洗回对手的牌库。

attacks.name: Disarming Voice
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Confused.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于混乱状态。

attacks.name: Mad Bite
attacks.desc: This attack does 30 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦每有 1 个伤害指示物，此招式就造成 +30 伤害。

abilities.name: Battle-Hardened
abilities.desc: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Basic {F} Energy cards from your hand to this Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌将此宝可梦放置到后备时，你可以从手牌中把最多 2 张基本 {F} 能量卡附着于此宝可梦。

attacks.name: Double Scratch
attacks.desc: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛 2 次硬币。每次出现正面，此招式就造成 20 点伤害。

attacks.name: Illusory Hijacking
attacks.desc: This attack does 60 damage for each of your opponent’s Pokémon {ex} and Pokémon {V} in play.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手场上的宝可梦 ex 与宝可梦 {V} 每有 1 只，此招式就造成 60 点伤害。

attacks.name: Poisonous Musculature
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic {D} Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, this Pokémon is now Poisoned.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 张基本 {D} 能量卡并附着于此宝可梦。然后洗牌。若以此方式将能量附着于宝可梦，则此宝可梦现在处于中毒状态。

attacks.name: Chain-Crazed
attacks.desc: If this Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 130 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦处于中毒状态，则此招式造成 +130 伤害。

attacks.name: Dirty Headbutt
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use Dirty Headbutt.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用肮脏头撞。

abilities.name: Oh No You Don’t
abilities.desc: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, and if you have any Pecharunt {ex} in play, your opponent takes 1 fewer Prize card.
abilities.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦因对手宝可梦的招式伤害而被击倒，且你场上有桃歹郎 ex，则对手获得的奖赏卡减少 1 张。

attacks.name: Irritated Outburst
attacks.desc: This attack does 60 damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手每获得 1 张奖赏卡，此招式就造成 60 点伤害。

abilities.name: Subjugating Chains
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may switch 1 of your Benched {D} Pokémon, except any Pecharunt {ex}, with your Active Pokémon. If you do, the new Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. You can’t use more than 1 Subjugating Chains Ability each turn.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，将后备的 1 只 {D} 宝可梦（桃歹郎 ex 除外）与自己的战斗宝可梦互换。若这样做，新的战斗宝可梦现在处于中毒状态。每回合只能使用 1 次征服锁链特性。

abilities.name: ACE Nullifier
abilities.desc: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, your opponent can’t play any {ACE SPEC} cards from their hand.
abilities.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦附着了宝可梦道具，则对手无法从手牌中打出任何 {ACE SPEC} 卡。

attacks.name: Rigidify
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，此宝可梦受到的招式伤害 -30（计算弱点和抗性之后）。

attacks.name: Trifrost
attacks.desc: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 110 damage to 3 of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置此宝可梦身上的所有能量。此招式对对手的 3 只宝可梦造成 110 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不适用弱点与抗性。）

abilities.name: Plasma Bane
abilities.desc: If your opponent has any cards in their discard pile that have "Colress" in the name, this Pokémon can use the Trifrost attack for {C}.
abilities.desc_zh: 若对手的弃牌堆中有名称中含有「阿克罗马」的卡，则此宝可梦可以用 {C} 使用三重霜招式。

attacks.name: Colorful Catch
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards of different types, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 3 张不同类型的基本能量卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Bind Down
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon can’t retreat.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，战斗宝可梦无法撤退。

attacks.name: Miasma Wind
attacks.desc: This attack does 100 damage for each Special Condition affecting your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦每处于 1 种特殊状态，此招式就造成 100 点伤害。

abilities.name: Selective Slime
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, choose Burned, Confused, or Poisoned. Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，抛硬币。若为正面，选择灼伤、混乱或中毒。对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于该特殊状态。

attacks.name: Reaping Dash
attacks.desc: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools and Special Energy from your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 在造成伤害之前，弃置对手战斗宝可梦身上的所有宝可梦道具和特殊能量。

attacks.name: Syrup Storm
attacks.desc: This attack does 30 more damage for each {G} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 自己所有宝可梦身上每附着 1 个 {G} 能量，此招式就造成 +30 伤害。

abilities.name: Ripening Charge
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic {G} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, heal 30 damage from that Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，从手牌中把 1 张基本 {G} 能量卡附着于自己的 1 只宝可梦。若以此方式将能量附着于宝可梦，则回复那只宝可梦的 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，此招式造成 +10 伤害。

attacks.name: Flare Strike
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use Flare Strike.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用「烈焰打击」。

attacks.name: Garnet Volley
attacks.desc: This attack does 180 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式对对手的 1 只宝可梦造成 180 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不适用弱点与抗性。）

attacks.name: Power Splash
attacks.desc: This attack does 40 damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦身上每附着 1 个能量，此招式就造成 40 点伤害。

attacks.name: Larimar Rain
attacks.desc: Look at the top 20 cards of your deck and attach any number of Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 查看自己牌库上方的 20 张卡，从中以任意方式把任意数量的能量卡附着于自己的宝可梦。将其余的卡洗回牌库。

abilities.name: Primal Knowledge
abilities.desc: Attacks used by your Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent’s Active Evolution Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
abilities.desc_zh: 自己的宝可梦使用的招式对对手战斗的进化宝可梦造成 +30 伤害（在应用弱点和抗性之前）。

attacks.name: Haymaker
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use Haymaker.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用猛击。

abilities.name: Food Prep
abilities.desc: Attacks used by this Pokémon cost {C} less for each Kofu card in your discard pile.
abilities.desc_zh: 自己弃牌堆中每有 1 张卡芙卡，此宝可梦使用的招式费用就减少 {C}。

attacks.name: Hard Crunch
attacks.desc: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 80 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦身上已有伤害指示物，则此招式造成 +80 伤害。

abilities.name: Impervious Shell
abilities.desc: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon if that damage is 200 or more.
abilities.desc_zh: 若伤害为 200 或更多，则防止对手宝可梦的招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害。

attacks.name: Sonic Edge
attacks.desc: This attack’s damage isn’t affected by any effects on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式的伤害不受对手的战斗宝可梦身上任何效果的影响。

abilities.name: Food Prep
abilities.desc: Attacks used by this Pokémon cost {C} less for each Kofu card in your discard pile.
abilities.desc_zh: 自己弃牌堆中每有 1 张卡芙卡，此宝可梦使用的招式费用就减少 {C}。

attacks.name: Jolting Charge
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic {G} Energy cards and up to 2 Basic {L} Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 张基本 {G} 能量卡和最多 2 张基本 {L} 能量卡，以任意方式附着于自己的宝可梦。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Charged Web
attacks.desc: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is a Pokémon {ex} or Pokémon {V}, this attack does 110 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦是宝可梦 ex 或宝可梦 {V}，则此招式造成 +110 伤害。

attacks.name: Fulgurite
attacks.desc: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. During your opponent’s next turn, they can’t play any Item cards from their hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置此宝可梦身上的所有能量。在对手的下个回合中，对手无法从手牌中打出任何物品卡。

attacks.name: Dangle Tail
attacks.desc: Put a Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 从弃牌堆中把 1 只宝可梦加入手牌。

attacks.name: Seek Inspiration
attacks.desc: Discard the top card of your deck, and if that card is a Pokémon that doesn’t have a Rule Box, choose 1 of its attacks and use it as this attack. (Pokémon {ex}, Pokémon {V}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置自己牌库上方的 1 张卡，若该卡是不具有规则栏的宝可梦，则选择其 1 个招式并作为此招式使用。（宝可梦 ex、宝可梦 {V} 等具有规则栏。）

attacks.name: Flower Shower
attacks.desc: Each player draws 3 cards.
attacks.desc_zh: 每位玩家抽 3 张牌。

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，此招式的伤害 +20。

attacks.name: Allure
attacks.desc: Draw a card.
attacks.desc_zh: 抽 1 张牌。

attacks.name: Iron Tackle
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 20 点伤害。

attacks.name: Knickknack Carrying
attacks.desc: Search your deck for a Pokémon Tool card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张宝可梦道具卡，展示后加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Raging Hammer
attacks.desc: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦每有 1 个伤害指示物，此招式就造成 +10 伤害。

attacks.name: Iron Blaster
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用招式。

abilities.name: Metal Bridge
abilities.desc: All of your Pokémon that have {M} Energy attached have no Retreat Cost.
abilities.desc_zh: 自己所有附着了 {M} 能量的宝可梦没有撤退费用。

attacks.name: Thunderburst Storm
attacks.desc: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦身上每附着 1 个能量，此招式就对对手的 1 只宝可梦造成 30 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不适用弱点与抗性。）

attacks.name: Triple Stab
attacks.desc: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛 3 次硬币。每次出现正面，此招式就造成 10 点伤害。

abilities.name: Jewel Seeker
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, if you have any Tera Pokémon in play, you may search your deck for up to 2 Trainer cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌打出此宝可梦以进化自己的 1 只宝可梦时，若你场上有太晶宝可梦，则你可以使用 1 次，从牌库中检索最多 2 张训练家卡，展示后加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Assault Landing
attacks.desc: If there is no Stadium in play, this attack does nothing.
attacks.desc_zh: 若场上没有竞技场，则此招式无效。

abilities.name: Fan Call
abilities.desc: Once during your first turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 {C} Pokémon with 100 HP or less, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can’t use more than 1 Fan Call Ability during your turn.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的首个回合中，你可以使用 1 次，从牌库中检索最多 3 只 HP 为 100 或以下的 {C} 宝可梦，展示后加入手牌。然后洗牌。你的回合中只能使用 1 次风扇呼唤特性。

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用招式。

abilities.name: Curly Wall
abilities.desc: As long as you have at least 1 other Bouffalant in play, all of your Basic {C} Pokémon take 60 less damage from attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). The effect of Curly Wall doesn’t stack.
abilities.desc_zh: 只要场上还有至少 1 只其他的爆爆头水牛，自己所有基本 {C} 宝可梦受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害减少 60 点（在应用弱点和抗性之后）。卷毛之墙的效果不会叠加。

attacks.name: Unified Beatdown
attacks.desc: If you go second, you can’t use this attack during your first turn. This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 若你是后攻，则你无法在自己的首个回合中使用此招式。自己的后备宝可梦每有 1 只，此招式就造成 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Crown Opal
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic non-{C} Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，防止非 {C} 的基础宝可梦的招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害。

attacks.name: Precocious Evolution
attacks.desc: If you go first, you can use this attack during your first turn. Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 若你是先攻，则你可以在自己的首个回合中使用此招式。从牌库中检索 1 张可从此宝可梦进化的卡，放置于此宝可梦上使其进化。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Ice Age
attacks.desc: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is a {N} Pokémon, it is now Paralyzed.
attacks.desc_zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦是 {N} 宝可梦，则其现在处于麻痹状态。

attacks.name: Black Frost
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦也会受到 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Big Bite
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon can’t retreat.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，战斗宝可梦无法撤退。

abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.desc: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦位于战斗区且受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），则在使用招式的宝可梦上放置 3 个伤害指示物。

abilities.name: Up-Tempo
abilities.desc: You must put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.
abilities.desc_zh: 为了使用此特性，你必须将手牌中的 1 张卡置于牌库下方。在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，抽牌直到手牌有 5 张。

attacks.name: Delightful Kiss
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic {P} Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 张基本 {P} 能量卡并附着于自己的 1 只后备宝可梦。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Eon Blade
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用招式。

abilities.name: Skyliner
abilities.desc: Your Basic Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost.
abilities.desc_zh: 自己场上的基础宝可梦没有撤退费用。

attacks.name: Splashing Dodge
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，则在对手的下个回合中，防止对此宝可梦造成的所有招式伤害与效果。

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索至多 2 张基本能量卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 只基础宝可梦并放置到后备。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Screech
attacks.desc: During your next turn, the Defending Pokémon takes 50 more damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，战斗宝可梦受到招式的伤害 +50（在应用弱点和抗性之后）。

attacks.name: Reversing Storm
attacks.desc: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 你可以将此宝可梦与自己的 1 只后备宝可梦互换。

attacks.name: Sonic Peridot
attacks.desc: This attack does 100 damage to each of your opponent’s Pokémon {ex} and Pokémon {V}. This attack’s damage isn’t affected by Weakness or Resistance.
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式对对手的每 1 只宝可梦 ex 和宝可梦 {V} 造成 100 点伤害。此招式的伤害不受弱点或抗性影响。

attacks.name: Strike It Rich
attacks.desc: If this Pokémon evolved from Gimmighoul during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦在本回合从索财灵进化而来，则此招式造成 +90 伤害。

attacks.name: Surf Back
attacks.desc: You may shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 你可以将此宝可梦及其身上的所有卡洗回牌库。

attacks.name: Deleting Slash
attacks.desc: If your opponent has 3 or more Benched Pokémon, this attack does 80 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若对手有 3 只或更多的后备宝可梦，则此招式造成 +80 伤害。

attacks.name: Humming Charge
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 张基本能量卡，以任意方式附着于自己的宝可梦。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Cotton Wings
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，在对手的下个回合中，防止招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害。

attacks.name: Time Manipulation
attacks.desc: Search your deck for 2 cards, shuffle your deck, then put those cards on top of it in any order.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 2 张卡，洗牌，然后以任意顺序将这些卡置于牌库上方。

attacks.name: Fully Singe
attacks.desc: Discard an Energy from your opponent’s Active Pokémon {ex}.
attacks.desc_zh: 从对手的战斗宝可梦 ex 上弃置 1 个能量。

attacks.name: Disarming Voice
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Confused.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于混乱状态。

attacks.name: Vengeful Crush
attacks.desc: This attack does 30 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手每获得 1 张奖赏卡，此招式就造成 +30 伤害。

abilities.name: Sudden Shearing
abilities.desc: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard the top card of your opponent’s deck.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌将此宝可梦放置到后备时，你可以弃置对手牌库上方的 1 张卡。

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.desc: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只基础宝可梦并放置于后备。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Wander About
attacks.desc: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 将此宝可梦与你的 1 只后备宝可梦互换。

attacks.name: Hazardous Greed
attacks.desc: If there are 3 or fewer cards in your deck, this attack also does 120 damage to 2 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 若自己牌库中的卡为 3 张或更少，则此招式还对对手的 2 只后备宝可梦造成 120 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不适用弱点与抗性。）

attacks.name: Entangling Whip
attacks.desc: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置自己牌库上方的 3 张卡。

abilities.name: Victory Cheer
abilities.desc: Attacks used by your Evolution {R} Pokémon do 10 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
abilities.desc_zh: 自己的进化 {R} 宝可梦使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦造成 +10 伤害（在应用弱点和抗性之前）。

attacks.name: Torcherto
attacks.desc: This attack does 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s).
attacks.desc_zh: 自己与对手的后备宝可梦每有 1 只，此招式就造成 +20 伤害。

abilities.name: Unaware
abilities.desc: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent’s Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)
abilities.desc_zh: 防止对手宝可梦使用的招式对此宝可梦造成的所有效果。（伤害不是效果。）

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.desc: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从此宝可梦身上弃置 1 个能量。

attacks.name: Leap Out
attacks.desc: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 将此宝可梦与你的 1 只后备宝可梦互换。

attacks.name: Hypno Splash
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于睡眠状态。

abilities.name: Sparkling Scales
abilities.desc: Prevent all damage from and effects of attacks from your opponent’s Tera Pokémon done to this Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 防止对手太晶宝可梦的招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害和效果。

attacks.name: Icicle Loop
attacks.desc: Put an Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 将此宝可梦身上附着的 1 个能量加入手牌。

abilities.name: Snow Sink
abilities.desc: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Stadium in play.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌将此宝可梦放置到后备时，你可以弃置场上 1 张竞技场。

attacks.name: Topaz Bolt
attacks.desc: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从此宝可梦身上弃置 3 个能量。

abilities.name: Resolute Heart
abilities.desc: If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.
abilities.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦的 HP 为满且将被招式的伤害击倒，则它不会被击倒，其剩余 HP 变为 10。

abilities.name: Overvolt Discharge
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may attach up to 3 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your {L} Pokémon in any way you like. If you use this Ability, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，从弃牌堆中以任意方式把最多 3 张基本能量卡附着于自己的 {L} 宝可梦。若你使用此特性，则此宝可梦被击倒。

attacks.name: Crushing Pulse
attacks.desc: Your opponent reveals their hand. Discard all Item cards and Pokémon Tool cards you find there.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手展示其手牌。弃置其中找到的所有物品卡和宝可梦道具卡。

attacks.name: Energy Short
attacks.desc: This attack does 20 damage for each Energy attached to your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦身上每附着 1 个能量，此招式就造成 20 点伤害。

attacks.name: Summon Lightning
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 {L} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 只 {L} 宝可梦，展示后加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Prize Count
attacks.desc: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, this attack does 90 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若你剩余的奖赏卡比对手多，则此招式造成 +90 伤害。

abilities.name: Wonder Kiss
abilities.desc: When your opponent’s Active Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, take 1 more Prize card. The effect of Wonder Kiss doesn’t stack.
abilities.desc_zh: 当对手的战斗宝可梦被击倒时，抛硬币。若为正面，则多获得 1 张奖赏卡。奇迹之吻的效果不会叠加。

attacks.name: Painful Memories
attacks.desc: Put 2 damage counters on each of your opponent’s Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的每只宝可梦上放置 2 个伤害指示物。

attacks.name: Full Heart
attacks.desc: Attach up to 2 Basic {P} Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like.
attacks.desc_zh: 从手牌中以任意方式把最多 2 张基本 {P} 能量卡附着于自己的宝可梦。

attacks.name: Guardian Burst
attacks.desc: If you don’t have Uxie and Azelf on your Bench, this attack does nothing.
attacks.desc_zh: 若你的后备没有由克希和亚克诺姆，则此招式无效。

attacks.name: Neurokinesis
attacks.desc: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on all of your opponent’s Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手所有宝可梦身上每有 1 个伤害指示物，此招式就造成 +10 伤害。

attacks.name: Law of the Underworld
attacks.desc: Put 6 damage counters on each Pokémon that has an Ability (both yours and your opponent’s).
attacks.desc_zh: 在双方所有拥有特性的宝可梦上各放置 6 个伤害指示物。

abilities.name: Beckoning Tail
abilities.desc: You must discard a Chill Teaser Toy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
abilities.desc_zh: 为了使用此特性，你必须从手牌中弃置 1 张「冰凉逗猫玩具」卡。在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，将对手的 1 只后备宝可梦换入战斗区。

attacks.name: Electromagnetic Sonar
attacks.desc: Put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 从弃牌堆中把 1 张训练家卡加入手牌。

attacks.name: Sand Tomb
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon can’t retreat.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，战斗宝可梦无法撤退。

attacks.name: Barite Jail
attacks.desc: Put damage counters on each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon until its remaining HP is 100.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的每只后备宝可梦上放置伤害指示物，直到其剩余 HP 为 100。

abilities.name: Tera
abilities.desc: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent’s).
abilities.desc_zh: 只要此宝可梦位于后备，就防止双方招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害。

attacks.name: Tantrum
attacks.desc: This Pokémon is now Confused.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦现在处于混乱状态。

attacks.name: Destined Fight
attacks.desc: Both Active Pokémon are Knocked Out.
attacks.desc_zh: 双方的战斗宝可梦都被击倒。

abilities.name: Sticky Bind
abilities.desc: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, Benched Stage 2 Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s) have no Abilities.
abilities.desc_zh: 只要此宝可梦位于后备，双方后备的 2 阶进化宝可梦都没有特性。

attacks.name: Unrelenting Onslaught
attacks.desc: If 1 of your other Ancient Pokémon used an attack during your last turn, this attack does 150 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若自己的其他 1 只古代宝可梦在你的上个回合中使用过招式，则此招式造成 +150 伤害。

attacks.name: Stomp Off
attacks.desc: Discard the top card of your opponent’s deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置对手牌库上方的 1 张卡。

attacks.name: Stomp Off
attacks.desc: Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent’s deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置对手牌库上方的 2 张卡。

attacks.name: Crashing Headbutt
attacks.desc: Discard the top 3 cards of your opponent’s deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置对手牌库上方的 3 张卡。

attacks.name: Obsidian
attacks.desc: This attack also does 130 damage to 2 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式还对对手的 2 只后备宝可梦造成 130 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不适用弱点与抗性。）

attacks.name: Poison Chain
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent’s next turn, that Pokémon can’t retreat.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于中毒状态。在对手的下个回合中，那只宝可梦无法撤退。

abilities.name: Toxic Subjugation
abilities.desc: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, put 5 more damage counters on your opponent’s Poisoned Pokémon during Pokémon Checkup.
abilities.desc_zh: 只要此宝可梦位于战斗区，在宝可梦检查时，在对手的中毒宝可梦上多放置 5 个伤害指示物。

attacks.name: Surprise Pump
attacks.desc: This attack’s damage isn’t affected by any effects on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式的伤害不受对手的战斗宝可梦身上任何效果的影响。

attacks.name: Cinnabar Lure
attacks.desc: Look at the top 10 cards of your deck. You may put any number of Pokémon you find there onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 查看你的牌库上方的 10 张卡。你可以将其中任意数量的宝可梦放到你的后备。将其余的卡洗回你的牌库。

attacks.name: Great Swing
attacks.desc: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从此宝可梦身上弃置 1 个能量。

abilities.name: Born to Slack
abilities.desc: If your opponent has no Pokémon {ex} or Pokémon {V} in play, this Pokémon can’t attack.
abilities.desc_zh: 若对手场上没有宝可梦 {ex} 或宝可梦 {V}，此宝可梦无法使用招式。

attacks.name: Ready to Ram
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 6 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，若此宝可梦受到招式伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），在攻击的宝可梦上放置 6 个伤害指示物。

attacks.name: Smashing Headbutt
attacks.desc: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从此宝可梦身上弃置 2 个能量。

attacks.name: Prism Charge
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards of different types and attach them to your Tera Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 3 张属性不同的基本能量卡，并以你喜欢的方式附着于你的太晶宝可梦。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Itchy Pollen
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, they can’t play any Item cards from their hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，对手无法从手牌中使用任何物品卡。

attacks.name: Verdant Storm
attacks.desc: This attack does 60 damage for each Energy attached to all of your opponent’s Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手所有宝可梦身上附着的能量每有 1 个，此招式造成 60 点伤害。

attacks.name: Moss Agate
attacks.desc: Heal 100 damage from each of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 回复你的每只后备宝可梦的 100 点伤害。

attacks.name: Triple Spin
attacks.desc: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛 3 次硬币。每次出现正面，此招式就造成 10 点伤害。

abilities.name: Wafting Heal
abilities.desc: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may heal all damage from your Active {G} Pokémon. If you healed any damage in this way, discard all Energy from that Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌中打出此宝可梦来进化你的 1 只宝可梦时，你可以回复你的战斗 {G} 宝可梦的所有伤害。若你以此方式回复了伤害，弃置该宝可梦身上的所有能量。

attacks.name: Burning Charge
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 张基本能量卡，并附着于你的 1 只宝可梦。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Carnelian
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用招式。

attacks.name: Rapid Draw
attacks.desc: Draw 2 cards.
attacks.desc_zh: 抽 2 张牌。

abilities.name: Festival Lead
abilities.desc: If Festival Grounds is in play, this Pokémon may use an attack it has twice. If the first attack Knocks Out your opponent’s Active Pokémon, you may attack again after your opponent chooses a new Active Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 若场上有「庆典会场」，则此宝可梦可以使用其拥有的招式 2 次。若第一次招式击倒了对手的战斗宝可梦，则你可以在对手选择新的战斗宝可梦后再次攻击。

attacks.name: Severe Squall
attacks.desc: This attack does 60 damage to each of your opponent’s Pokémon {ex}. This attack’s damage isn’t affected by Weakness or Resistance.
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式对对手的每只宝可梦 {ex} 造成 60 点伤害。此招式的伤害不受弱点或抗性影响。

attacks.name: Aquamarine
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用招式。

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.desc: This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦身上附着的伤害指示物每有 1 个，此招式造成 10 点伤害。

attacks.name: Frost Bullet
attacks.desc: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式还对对手的 1 只后备宝可梦造成 30 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Euclase
attacks.desc: Knock Out 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon that has exactly 6 damage counters on it.
attacks.desc_zh: 击倒对手的 1 只身上恰好有 6 个伤害指示物的宝可梦。

attacks.name: Flashing Spear
attacks.desc: You may discard up to 2 Basic Energy from your Benched Pokémon. This attack does 90 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.
attacks.desc_zh: 你可以从你的后备宝可梦身上弃置最多 2 个基本能量。以此方式弃置的每张卡使此招式的伤害 +90。

attacks.name: Dravite
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用招式。

attacks.name: Sneaky Placement
attacks.desc: Put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的 1 只宝可梦上放置 2 个伤害指示物。

abilities.name: Festival Lead
abilities.desc: If Festival Grounds is in play, this Pokémon may use an attack it has twice in succession. If the first attack Knocks Out your opponent’s Active Pokémon, you may use an attack again after your opponent chooses a new Active Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 若场上有庆典广场，此宝可梦可以连续 2 次使用其拥有的 1 个招式。若第一个招式击倒了对手的战斗宝可梦，你可以在对手选择新的战斗宝可梦后再次使用招式。

attacks.name: Moon Mirage
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Confused.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于混乱状态。

attacks.name: Onyx
attacks.desc: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and take a Prize card.
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置此宝可梦身上的所有能量，并拿取 1 张奖赏卡。

abilities.name: Insomnia
abilities.desc: This Pokémon can’t be Asleep.
abilities.desc_zh: 此宝可梦无法处于睡眠状态。

attacks.name: Jewel Breaker
attacks.desc: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is a Tera Pokémon, this attack does 230 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦是太晶宝可梦，此招式的伤害 +230。

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks if that damage is 60 or less.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，若该伤害为 60 点或以下，防止此宝可梦受到的所有招式伤害。

attacks.name: Scale Hurricane
attacks.desc: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads. If at least 2 of them are heads, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛 4 次硬币。此招式每出现 1 次正面就造成 60 点伤害。若其中至少有 2 个正面，对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于麻痹状态。

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon can’t retreat.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，战斗宝可梦无法撤退。

abilities.name: Exploding Needles
abilities.desc: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, put 6 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦位于战斗区，且被对手宝可梦的招式伤害击倒，在攻击的宝可梦上放置 6 个伤害指示物。

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Burned.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于灼伤状态。

abilities.name: Magma Surge
abilities.desc: During Pokémon Checkup, put 3 more damage counters on your opponent’s Burned Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 在宝可梦检查时，在对手的灼伤宝可梦上多放置 3 个伤害指示物。

attacks.name: Back Draft
attacks.desc: This attack does 30 damage for each Basic Energy card in your opponent’s discard pile.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的弃牌堆中的基本能量卡每有 1 张，此招式造成 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Flamebody Cannon
attacks.desc: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack also does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置此宝可梦身上的所有能量，此招式还对对手的 1 只后备宝可梦造成 90 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Scorching Cyclone
attacks.desc: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 将此宝可梦身上的 1 个能量移动到你的 1 只后备宝可梦上。

abilities.name: Scalding Steam
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may make your opponent’s Active Pokémon Burned.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，若此宝可梦位于战斗区，你可以使用 1 次，使对手的战斗宝可梦处于灼伤状态。

attacks.name: Aqua Slash
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用招式。

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.desc: This attack does 50 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦身上附着的 {W} 能量每有 1 个，此招式的伤害 +50。

attacks.name: Voltaic Chain
attacks.desc: This attack does 20 more damage for each {L} Energy attached to all of your Iono’s Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 你所有奇树的宝可梦身上附着的 {L} 能量每有 1 个，此招式的伤害 +20。

attacks.name: Thump-Thump Boom
attacks.desc: This Pokémon does 100 damage to itself. Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is Knocked Out.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦对自身造成 100 点伤害。抛硬币。若为正面，对手的战斗宝可梦被击倒。

attacks.name: Zapping Short
attacks.desc: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent’s Active Pokémon. If you discarded a Pokémon Tool in this way, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attacks.desc_zh: 在造成伤害之前，弃置对手战斗宝可梦身上的所有宝可梦道具。若你以此方式弃置了宝可梦道具，对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于麻痹状态。

attacks.name: Thunderous Bolt
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用招式。

abilities.name: Electric Streamer
abilities.desc: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic {L} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Iono’s Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以不限次数，从手牌中将 1 张基本 {L} 能量卡附着于你的 1 只奇树的宝可梦。

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，此招式的伤害 +20。

abilities.name: Flashing Draw
abilities.desc: You must discard a Basic {L} Energy from this Pokémon in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.
abilities.desc_zh: 你须从此宝可梦身上弃置 1 个基本 {L} 能量才能使用此特性。在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，抽牌直到你的手牌有 6 张。

attacks.name: Cursed Words
attacks.desc: Your opponent chooses 3 cards from their hand and shuffles those cards into their deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手从其手牌中选择 3 张卡，并将那些卡洗回其牌库。

attacks.name: Conjoined Beams
attacks.desc: If Beldum and Metang are on your Bench, this attack does 150 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若你的后备中有铁哑铃和金属怪，此招式的伤害 +150。

attacks.name: Hold Still
attacks.desc: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 回复此宝可梦的 10 点伤害。

attacks.name: Inviting Flowers
attacks.desc: You may search your deck for any number of Basic Lillie’s Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 你可以从牌库中检索任意数量的基础莉莉艾的宝可梦，并将它们放到你的后备。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Fade Out
attacks.desc: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 将此宝可梦和其身上附着的所有卡放入你的手牌。

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 只基础宝可梦并放置到后备。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Rumbling March
attacks.desc: This attack does 40 more damage for each Stage 2 Pokémon on your Bench.
attacks.desc_zh: 你的后备中的 2 阶进化宝可梦每有 1 只，此招式的伤害 +40。

abilities.name: Mammoth Hauler
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，从牌库中检索 1 只宝可梦，展示它，并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，弃置对手的战斗宝可梦身上的 1 个能量。

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 20 点伤害。

attacks.name: Dig It Up
attacks.desc: Look at the top card of your deck. You may discard that card.
attacks.desc_zh: 查看你的牌库上方的 1 张卡。你可以弃置那张卡。

attacks.name: Turf Maker
attacks.desc: Search your deck for a Stadium card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张竞技场卡，展示它，并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Rumble
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon can’t retreat.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，战斗宝可梦无法撤退。

attacks.name: Break Ground
attacks.desc: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式还对你的每只后备宝可梦造成 20 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Cracking Stomp
attacks.desc: Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent’s deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置对手牌库上方的 2 张卡。

abilities.name: Daunting Gaze
abilities.desc: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can’t play any Item cards from their hand.
abilities.desc_zh: 只要此宝可梦位于战斗区，对手无法从手牌中使用任何物品卡。

abilities.name: Champion’s Call
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Cynthia’s Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，从牌库中检索 1 只竹兰的宝可梦，展示它，并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Corkscrew Dive
attacks.desc: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 你可以抽牌，直到手牌有 6 张。

attacks.name: Draconic Buster

attacks.desc_zh: 弃置此宝可梦身上的所有能量。

attacks.name: Running Charge
attacks.desc: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.
attacks.desc_zh: 反复抛硬币，直到出现反面。此招式每出现 1 次正面就造成 40 点伤害。

abilities.name: Mud Coat
abilities.desc: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
abilities.desc_zh: 此宝可梦受到的招式伤害减少 30 点（计算弱点与抗性后）。

attacks.name: Slight Intrusion
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 10 点伤害。

attacks.name: Pull
attacks.desc: Switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
attacks.desc_zh: 将对手的 1 只后备宝可梦换入战斗区。

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦也会受到 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Rock Kagura
attacks.desc: Search your deck for a Basic {F} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张基本 {F} 能量卡，并附着于你的 1 只宝可梦。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Mountain Ramming
attacks.desc: Discard the top card of your opponent’s deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置对手牌库上方的 1 张卡。

attacks.name: Raging Curse
attacks.desc: This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Cynthia’s Pokémon. This attack’s damage isn’t affected by Weakness.
attacks.desc_zh: 你的后备中所有竹兰的宝可梦身上的伤害指示物每有 1 个，此招式造成 10 点伤害。此招式的伤害不受弱点影响。

attacks.name: Vigorous Tackle
attacks.desc: If this Pokémon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 120 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦身上没有伤害指示物，此招式的伤害 +120。

attacks.name: Boss Headbutt
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use Boss Headbutt.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用头目头锤。

attacks.name: Clean Hit
attacks.desc: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦是进化宝可梦，此招式的伤害 +50。

attacks.name: Gnaw Through

attacks.desc_zh: 在造成伤害前，弃置对手的战斗宝可梦身上的所有宝可梦道具。

abilities.name: Greedy Order
abilities.desc: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put up to 2 Arven’s Sandwich cards from your discard pile into your hand.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌打出此宝可梦以进化你的 1 只宝可梦时，你可以从弃牌堆中把最多 2 张派帕的三明治卡加入手牌。

attacks.name: Damage Rush
attacks.desc: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads.
attacks.desc_zh: 反复抛硬币，直到出现反面。每出现 1 次正面，此招式的伤害 +50。

attacks.name: Mega Drain

attacks.desc_zh: 回复此宝可梦的 30 点伤害。

attacks.desc_zh: 弃置场上的 1 张竞技场卡。

attacks.name: Gadget Show
attacks.desc: This attack does 30 damage for each Pokémon Tool attached to all of your Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 附着于你所有宝可梦的宝可梦道具每有 1 个，此招式造成 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Petal Blade Dance
attacks.desc: Discard 2 Basic {G} Energy cards from your hand. If you can’t discard 2 cards in this way, this attack does nothing.
attacks.desc_zh: 从手牌中弃置 2 张基本 {G} 能量卡。若你无法以此方式弃置 2 张卡，此招式无效。

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 10 点伤害。

attacks.name: Rocket Rush

abilities.name: Charging Up

abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，从弃牌堆中把 1 张基本能量卡附着于此宝可梦。

attacks.name: Nutrients

attacks.desc_zh: 回复你的 1 只宝可梦的 40 点伤害。

attacks.name: Oil Salvo
attacks.desc: Choose 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon 6 times. (You can choose the same Pokémon more than once.) For each time you chose a Pokémon, do 20 damage to it. This damage isn’t affected by Weakness or Resistance.
attacks.desc_zh: 选择对手的 1 只宝可梦，重复 6 次。（可以选择同一只宝可梦多次。）每选择 1 次宝可梦，就对其造成 20 点伤害。此伤害不受弱点或抗性影响。

attacks.name: Aroma Shot
attacks.desc: This Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦恢复所有特殊状态。

attacks.name: Punishing Fang
attacks.desc: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is a {D} Pokémon, this attack does 100 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦是 {D} 宝可梦，此招式的伤害 +100。

attacks.name: Cruel Coal
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于灼伤和混乱状态。

attacks.name: Scorching Fire
attacks.desc: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从此宝可梦身上弃置 1 个能量。

attacks.name: Collect

attacks.desc_zh: 抽 1 张牌。

attacks.name: Double Kick
attacks.desc: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛 2 次硬币。每出现 1 次正面，此招式造成 40 点伤害。

attacks.name: Inferno Kick Flurry
attacks.desc: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. This attack also does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 从此宝可梦身上弃置 2 个能量。此招式还对对手的 1 只后备宝可梦造成 120 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不适用弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Burned.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦陷入灼伤。

attacks.name: Gadget Show
attacks.desc: This attack does 30 damage for each Pokémon Tool attached to all of your Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 附着于你所有宝可梦的宝可梦道具每有 1 个，此招式造成 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Shell Press
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，此宝可梦受到的招式伤害 -10（在适用弱点和抗性之后）。

abilities.name: Diver’s Catch
abilities.desc: When 1 of your {W} Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, you may put all Basic {W} Energy attached to that Pokémon into your hand instead of the discard pile.
abilities.desc_zh: 当你的 1 只 {W} 宝可梦被对手的宝可梦的招式伤害击倒时，你可以把附着于该宝可梦的所有基本 {W} 能量加入手牌，而非放入弃牌堆。

attacks.name: Frozen Wood
attacks.desc: If this Pokémon has 2 or more {G} Energy attached, this attack does 120 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦身上附着有 2 个以上的 {G} 能量，此招式的伤害 +120。

attacks.name: Manual Wash
attacks.desc: Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 回复你的每只宝可梦的 10 点伤害。

attacks.name: Gadget Show

attacks.desc_zh: 附着于你所有宝可梦的宝可梦道具每有 1 个，此招式造成 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 10 点伤害。

attacks.name: Dive

attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，则在对手的下个回合中，防止对此宝可梦造成的所有招式伤害与效果。

attacks.name: Jamming Wing
attacks.desc: You may move an Energy from your opponent’s Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 你可以把对手的战斗宝可梦身上的 1 个能量移动到其 1 只后备宝可梦身上。

attacks.name: Wicked Thunder
attacks.desc: If this Pokémon has any Team Rocket’s Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦身上附着有火箭队的能量，此招式的伤害 +60。

attacks.name: Procurement
attacks.desc: Search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张物品卡，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Thunder Shock

attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，对手的战斗宝可梦陷入麻痹。

attacks.name: Hypnotic Ray

attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于睡眠状态。

attacks.name: Bench Manipulation
attacks.desc: Your opponent flips a coin for each of their Benched Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon for each tails. This attack’s damage isn’t affected by Weakness or Resistance.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手为其每只后备宝可梦抛 1 次硬币。每出现 1 次反面，此招式对对手的战斗宝可梦造成 80 点伤害。此招式的伤害不受弱点或抗性影响。

attacks.name: Erasure Ball

attacks.desc_zh: 你可以从你的后备宝可梦身上弃置最多 2 个能量。以此方式每弃置 1 张卡，此招式的伤害 +60。

abilities.desc_zh: 除非场上有 4 只以上的你的火箭队的宝可梦，否则此宝可梦无法使用招式。

attacks.desc_zh: 随机弃置对手手牌中的 1 张卡。

attacks.name: Gemstone Mimicry

attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦身上附着的能量每有 1 个，此招式的伤害 +40。

abilities.name: Rocket Brain

attacks.name: Impact Blow

attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用冲击重击。

abilities.name: Lose Cool

abilities.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦身上有 2 个以上的伤害指示物，此宝可梦使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦造成的伤害 +120（在适用弱点和抗性之前）。

attacks.desc_zh: 弃置对手牌库上方的 1 张卡。

attacks.name: Explosive Ascension

attacks.name: Demolition Tackle

attacks.desc_zh: 从对手的战斗宝可梦上弃置 1 个能量。

abilities.name: Sand Stream

abilities.desc_zh: 在宝可梦检查时，若此宝可梦位于战斗区，在对手的每只基础宝可梦上放置 2 个伤害指示物。

attacks.name: Mountain Drop

attacks.name: Steady Punch

attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，此招式的伤害 +20。

attacks.name: Harmonious Spirit Palm

attacks.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦与对手的战斗宝可梦身上附着的能量数量相同，此招式的伤害 +120。

attacks.name: Regi Charge

attacks.desc_zh: 从弃牌堆中把最多 2 张基本 {F} 能量卡附着于此宝可梦。

attacks.name: Giant Rock

attacks.desc_zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦是 2 阶进化宝可梦，此招式的伤害 +140。

attacks.name: Drag Down

attacks.desc_zh: 此招式对对手的每只宝可梦造成 30 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不适用弱点和抗性。）

abilities.name: Potent Glare

attacks.name: Surprise Attack

attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为反面，此招式无效。

attacks.name: Dark Awakening
attacks.desc: Choose up to 2 of your {D} Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 选择最多 2 只你的 {D} 宝可梦。对其中每只宝可梦，从牌库中检索 1 张由该宝可梦进化而来的卡，将其放置于该宝可梦上以使其进化。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Love Impact

attacks.desc_zh: 若你的后备宝可梦中有名称中含有「尼多王」的宝可梦，此招式的伤害 +120。

attacks.name: Horn Rend

attacks.desc_zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦身上已放置有伤害指示物，此招式的伤害 +60。

attacks.name: Tainted Horn

attacks.name: Confuse Ray

attacks.name: Assassin’s Return

attacks.desc_zh: 你可以将此宝可梦收回手牌。（弃置附着于此宝可梦的所有卡。）

abilities.name: Biting Spree

abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌打出此宝可梦以进化你的 1 只宝可梦时，你可以选择对手的 2 只宝可梦，在它们各自身上放置 2 个伤害指示物。

attacks.name: Gooped Up

attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于混乱状态。在对手的下个回合中，该宝可梦无法撤退。

abilities.name: Smog Signals

attacks.name: Explode Together Now

attacks.desc_zh: 场上的名称中含有「瓦斯弹」或「双弹瓦斯」的宝可梦（你的和对手的都包括）每有 1 只，此招式造成 40 点伤害。

attacks.name: Deceit

attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张支援者卡，展示它，并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Torment
