attacks.name: Strike the Sleeper
attacks.desc: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon for each damage counter on that Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的 1 只后备宝可梦身上的伤害指示物每有 1 个，此招式对该宝可梦造成 20 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不适用弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Roost
attacks.desc: Heal 50 damage from this Pokémon. During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t retreat.
attacks.desc_zh: 回复此宝可梦的 50 点伤害。在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法撤退。

attacks.name: Strong Bash
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon equal to the damage done to this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，若此宝可梦被招式造成伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），则在攻击的宝可梦上放置与此宝可梦所受到伤害相同数量的伤害指示物。

attacks.name: Dangerous Incisors
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦陷入中毒。

attacks.name: Reckless Abandon
attacks.desc: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this Pokémon also does 90 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛 2 次硬币。若 2 次都是反面，此宝可梦也对自己造成 90 点伤害。

attacks.name: Paw-cket Pilfer
attacks.desc: Choose a random card from your opponent’s hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从对手手牌中随机选择 1 张卡。对手展示那张卡并将其洗回牌库。

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.desc: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛 3 次硬币。每出现 1 次正面，此招式造成 20 点伤害。

attacks.name: Dizzy Punch
attacks.desc: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛 2 次硬币。此招式每出现 1 次正面就造成 90 点伤害。

attacks.name: Hacking
attacks.desc: Discard a card from your hand. If you do, your opponent discards a card from their hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 从手牌中弃置 1 张卡。若你这样做，对手从其手牌中弃置 1 张卡。

attacks.name: R Command
attacks.desc: This attack does 20 damage for each Supporter card that has “Team Rocket” in its name in your discard pile.
attacks.desc_zh: 你的弃牌堆中名称中含有「火箭队」的支援者卡每有 1 张，此招式造成 20 点伤害。

attacks.name: R Command
attacks.desc: This attack does 20 damage for each Supporter card that has “Team Rocket” in its name in your discard pile.
attacks.desc_zh: 你的弃牌堆中名称中含有「火箭队」的支援者卡每有 1 张，此招式造成 20 点伤害。

abilities.name: Reconstitute
abilities.desc: You must discard 2 cards from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw a card.
abilities.desc_zh: 你必须从手牌中弃置 2 张卡才能使用此特性。在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，抽 1 张牌。

attacks.name: Add On
attacks.desc: Draw 3 cards.
attacks.desc_zh: 抽 3 张牌。

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.desc: You may switch out your opponent’s Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 你可以将对手的战斗宝可梦换入后备。（由对手选择新的战斗宝可梦。）

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，对手的战斗宝可梦陷入麻痹。

attacks.name: Command the Grass
attacks.desc: You may search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 你可以从牌库中检索最多 3 张卡并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

abilities.name: Regal Cheer
abilities.desc: Attacks used by your Pokémon do 20 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
abilities.desc_zh: 你的宝可梦使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦造成的伤害 +20（在适用弱点和抗性之前）。

attacks.name: Collect

attacks.desc_zh: 抽 1 张牌。

attacks.name: Hide

attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，则在对手的下个回合中，防止对此宝可梦造成的所有招式伤害与效果。

attacks.name: Bemusing Aroma

abilities.name: Stimulated Evolution

attacks.name: Toxic Spore

attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦陷入中毒。

attacks.name: Dangerous Reaction

attacks.name: V-Force

attacks.name: Searing Flame

attacks.name: Fire Blast

attacks.name: Burn It All Up

attacks.name: Voltage Burst

attacks.name: Rest

attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦现在处于睡眠状态。回复此宝可梦的 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Dream Calling

attacks.desc_zh: 你可以从牌库中检索任意数量的玛珂莫卡，展示它们，并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Healing Wrapping

attacks.name: Jam-Packed

attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 只基础宝可梦并放置到后备。然后洗牌。

abilities.name: Sinister Surge
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Basic {D} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched {D} Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次此特性。从牌库中检索 1 张基本 {D} 能量卡，并附着于你的 1 只后备 {D} 宝可梦。然后洗牌。若你以此方式把能量附着于宝可梦，则在该宝可梦上放置 2 个伤害指示物。

attacks.name: Iron Feathers
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, this Pokémon takes 60 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，此宝可梦受到的招式伤害减少 60 点（计算弱点与抗性后）。

abilities.name: Emperor’s Stance
abilities.desc: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent’s Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)
abilities.desc_zh: 防止对手宝可梦使用的招式对此宝可梦造成的所有效果。（伤害不是效果。）

attacks.name: Iron Defense
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，在对手的下个回合中，防止招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害。

attacks.name: Triple Draw
attacks.desc: Draw 3 cards.
attacks.desc_zh: 抽 3 张牌。

attacks.name: Tool Drop
attacks.desc: This attack does 40 damage for each Pokémon Tool attached to all Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 所有宝可梦上附着的每张宝可梦道具，使此招式造成 40 点伤害。

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.desc: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.desc: Discard an Energy from your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从对手的战斗宝可梦上弃置 1 个能量。

attacks.name: Coated Attack
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，防止基础宝可梦的招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害。

attacks.name: Ball Roll
attacks.desc: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
attacks.desc_zh: 反复抛硬币，直到出现反面。每次正面，此招式造成 20 点伤害。

attacks.name: Round
attacks.desc: This attack does 40 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.
attacks.desc_zh: 场上的拥有轮唱招式的你的宝可梦每有 1 只，此招式造成 40 点伤害。

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.desc: Choose a random card from your opponent’s hand, and your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从对手的手牌中随机选择 1 张卡，对手展示该卡并将其洗回其牌库。

attacks.name: Dual Tail
attacks.desc: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 60 damage to each of 2 of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 从这只宝可梦身上弃置 2 个能量，此招式对对手的 2 只宝可梦各造成 60 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为反面，此招式无效。

abilities.name: Excited Dash
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, and if you have any Mega Evolution Pokémon {ex} in play, you may use this Ability. Switch this Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，若此宝可梦位于你的后备，且场上有你的超级进化宝可梦 ex，你可以使用 1 次此特性。将此宝可梦与你的战斗宝可梦互换。

attacks.name: Run Around
attacks.desc: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 将此宝可梦与你的 1 只后备宝可梦互换。

attacks.name: Gale Thrust
attacks.desc: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 170 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦在本回合中从你的后备移动到战斗区，此招式的伤害 +170。

attacks.name: Spiky Hopper
attacks.desc: This attack’s damage isn’t affected by any effects on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式的伤害不受对手的战斗宝可梦身上任何效果的影响。

abilities.name: Multiplying Cocoon
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Silcoon or a Cascoon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌将此宝可梦打出以进化你的 1 只宝可梦时，你可以使用 1 次此特性。从牌库中检索甲壳茧或盾甲茧，并放置于你的后备。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，对手的战斗宝可梦陷入麻痹。

attacks.name: Energy Straw
attacks.desc: Your opponent reveals their hand, and this attack does 80 damage for each Energy card you find there.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手展示其手牌，其中每有 1 张能量卡，此招式造成 80 点伤害。

attacks.name: Trading Places
attacks.desc: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 将此宝可梦与你的 1 只后备宝可梦互换。

attacks.name: Twilight Poison
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在陷入睡眠和中毒状态。

abilities.name: Boisterous Wind
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, put an Energy attached to your opponent’s Active Pokémon into their hand.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次此特性。抛硬币。若为正面，将对手的战斗宝可梦上附着的 1 个能量放回其手牌。

attacks.name: Flare Fall
attacks.desc: If you have at least 4 {R} Energy in play, this attack does 90 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若场上有你的至少 4 个 {R} 能量，此招式的伤害 +90。

abilities.name: Incandescent Body
abilities.desc: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Burned.
abilities.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦位于战斗区且受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），则使用招式的宝可梦现在处于灼伤状态。

attacks.name: Roasting Burn
attacks.desc: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon isn’t Burned, this attack does nothing.
attacks.desc_zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦未处于灼伤状态，此招式无效。

attacks.name: Power Stomp
attacks.desc: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从此宝可梦身上弃置 2 个能量。

attacks.name: Resentful Refrain
attacks.desc: This attack does 50 damage for each card in your opponent’s hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手手牌中每有 1 张卡，此招式造成 50 点伤害。

attacks.name: Absolute Snow
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于睡眠状态。

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 只基础宝可梦并放置到后备。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Sheer Cold
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon can’t use attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，防守宝可梦无法使用招式。

attacks.name: Cold Cyclone
attacks.desc: Move a {W} Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从此宝可梦身上把 1 个 {W} 能量移动到你的 1 只后备宝可梦。

abilities.name: Alluring Wings
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Each player draws a card.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，若此宝可梦位于战斗区，你可以使用 1 次此特性。双方玩家各抽 1 张卡。

attacks.name: Ice Shot
attacks.desc: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式还对对手的 1 只后备宝可梦造成 20 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点与抗性。）

attacks.name: Frosty Typhoon
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use Frosty Typhoon.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用冰霜台风。

attacks.name: Pouncing Trap
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon can’t retreat. During your next turn, the Defending Pokémon takes 100 more damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，受攻击的宝可梦无法撤退。在你的下个回合中，受攻击的宝可梦受到的招式伤害 +100（在计算弱点和抗性之后）。

attacks.name: Powerful Bolt
attacks.desc: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.
attacks.desc_zh: 附着于此宝可梦的每个能量抛 1 次硬币。每次正面，此招式造成 70 点伤害。

abilities.name: Frilled Generator
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, if you played Canari from your hand this turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for up to 2 Basic {L} Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，若你在本回合从手牌打出了卡娜莉，你可以使用 1 次此特性。从牌库中检索最多 2 张基本 {L} 能量卡，并附着于此宝可梦。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Fast Flight
attacks.desc: If you go first, you can use this attack during your first turn. Discard your hand and draw 5 cards.
attacks.desc_zh: 若你先攻，你可以在你的第一个回合中使用此招式。弃置你的手牌，抽 5 张卡。

attacks.name: Thunder Blast
attacks.desc: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从此宝可梦身上弃置 2 个能量。

attacks.name: Focused Wish
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，此招式的伤害 +20。

attacks.name: Tri Kinesis
attacks.desc: Flip 3 coins. If all of them are heads, Knock Out 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛 3 次硬币。若全部为正面，击倒对手的 1 只宝可梦。

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦也会受到 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.desc: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张从此宝可梦进化的卡并放置于此宝可梦上使其进化。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Assassin’s Magic
attacks.desc: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, place 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦受到特殊状态影响，在对手的 1 只后备宝可梦上放置 6 个伤害指示物。

attacks.name: Roto Call
attacks.desc: You may search your deck for any number of Pokémon that have “Rotom” in their name and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 你可以从牌库中检索任意数量名称中含有「洛托姆」的宝可梦，并放置于你的后备。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Gadget Show
attacks.desc: This attack does 30 damage for each Pokémon Tool attached to all of your Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 附着于你所有宝可梦的宝可梦道具每有 1 个，此招式造成 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Splashing Dodge
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，则在对手的下个回合中，防止对此宝可梦造成的所有招式伤害与效果。

attacks.name: Horrifying Revenge
attacks.desc: If any of your Hop’s Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent’s last turn, this attack does 100 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若你的任何赫普的宝可梦在上个对手回合中因招式伤害而被击倒，此招式的伤害 +100。

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon can’t retreat.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，战斗宝可梦无法撤退。

attacks.name: Phantasmal Barrage
attacks.desc: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon and place 12 damage counters on 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 弃置此宝可梦的所有能量，并在对手的 1 只宝可梦上放置 12 个伤害指示物。

attacks.name: Relentless Burrowing
attacks.desc: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard the top card of your opponent’s deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 反复抛硬币，直到出现反面。每次正面，弃置对手牌库顶部的 1 张卡。

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.desc: Draw a card.
attacks.desc_zh: 抽 1 张牌。

attacks.name: Seventh Kick
attacks.desc: If you don’t have exactly 7 cards in your hand, this attack does nothing.
attacks.desc_zh: 若你的手牌不是恰好 7 张，此招式无效。

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 10 点伤害。

attacks.name: Somersault Dive
attacks.desc: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 140 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium.
attacks.desc_zh: 若场上有竞技场卡，此招式的伤害 +140。然后，弃置该竞技场卡。

abilities.name: Tenacious Body
abilities.desc: If this Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.
abilities.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦将因招式伤害而被击倒，抛硬币。若为正面，此宝可梦不会被击倒，其剩余 HP 变为 10。

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，此宝可梦受到的招式伤害减少 20 点（在计算弱点与抗性之后）。

attacks.name: Tar Cannon
attacks.desc: This attack does 140 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon. If you don’t have 10 or more Basic {F} Energy cards in your discard pile, this attack does nothing. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式对对手的 1 只宝可梦造成 140 点伤害。若你的弃牌堆中没有 10 张或以上的基本 {F} 能量卡，此招式无效。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Bulky Bump
attacks.desc: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从此宝可梦身上弃置 3 个能量。

attacks.name: Settle the Score
attacks.desc: This attack does 60 more damage for each Prize card your opponent took during their last turn.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手在上个回合中拿取的每张奖赏卡，使此招式的伤害 +60。

attacks.name: Scarring Shout
attacks.desc: This attack does 70 damage for each damage counter on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦上每有 1 个伤害指示物，此招式造成 70 点伤害。

attacks.name: Punk Smash
attacks.desc: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从此宝可梦身上弃置 1 个能量。

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.desc: Discard a random card from your opponent’s hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 随机弃置对手手牌中的 1 张卡。

attacks.name: Outlaw Leg
attacks.desc: Discard a random card from your opponent’s hand. Discard the top card of your opponent’s deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 随机弃置对手手牌中的 1 张卡。弃置对手牌库顶部的 1 张卡。

abilities.name: Counterattacking Crest
abilities.desc: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 5 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦位于战斗区，且受到对手的宝可梦的招式伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），就在攻击的宝可梦上放置 5 个伤害指示物。

attacks.name: Master’s Punch
attacks.desc: If any of your Benched Pancham have any damage counters on them, this attack does 120 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若你的后备中有任何顽皮熊猫上放置有伤害指示物，此招式的伤害 +120。

attacks.name: Mochi Rush
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon’s Mochi Rush attack does 50 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦的麻糬突进招式的伤害 +50（在计算弱点和抗性之前）。

abilities.name: Final Chain
abilities.desc: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦因对手的宝可梦的招式伤害而被击倒，从牌库中检索 1 张卡并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.desc: Switch out your opponent’s Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 将对手的战斗宝可梦换入后备。（由对手选择新的战斗宝可梦。）

attacks.name: Rapid Draw
attacks.desc: Draw 2 cards.
attacks.desc_zh: 抽 2 张牌。

attacks.name: Double-Edged Slash
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 50 点伤害。

abilities.name: Supreme Overlord
abilities.desc: Attacks used by this Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon for each Prize card your opponent has taken (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
abilities.desc_zh: 对手已拿取的每张奖赏卡，使此宝可梦使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦造成的伤害 +30（在计算弱点和抗性之前）。

abilities.name: Evolutionary Guidance
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon has any Energy attached, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，若此宝可梦上附着有能量，你可以使用 1 次此特性。从牌库中检索 1 只进化宝可梦，展示并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Ryuno Glide
attacks.desc: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从此宝可梦身上弃置 2 个能量。

abilities.name: Sky Transport
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次此特性。将你的战斗宝可梦与你的 1 只后备宝可梦互换。

attacks.name: Breakthrough Assault
attacks.desc: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦在本回合从后备区移动到战斗区，此招式的伤害 +90。

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.desc: This attack’s damage isn’t affected by any effects on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式的伤害不受对手的战斗宝可梦身上任何效果的影响。

attacks.name: Rampaging Thunder
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用招式。

attacks.name: Knickknack Carrying
attacks.desc: Search your deck for a Pokémon Tool card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张宝可梦道具卡，展示后加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，则在对手的下个回合中，防止对此宝可梦造成的所有招式伤害与效果。

attacks.name: Enhanced Blade
attacks.desc: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 70 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦上附着有宝可梦道具，此招式的伤害 +70。

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 10 点伤害。

attacks.name: Poison Spray
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦陷入中毒。

attacks.name: Bloom Powder
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在陷入睡眠和中毒状态。

abilities.name: Lovely Fragrance

attacks.name: Dozing Draw
attacks.desc: This Pokémon is now Asleep. Draw 2 cards.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦现在处于睡眠状态。抽 2 张牌。

abilities.name: Lethargic Charge
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may use this Ability. Attach an Energy card from your hand to your Active Larry’s Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，若此宝可梦位于你的后备区，你可以使用 1 次此特性。从手牌中把 1 张能量卡附着于你的战斗中的青木的宝可梦。

attacks.name: Dragon Strike
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use Dragon Strike.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用「龙之打击」。

attacks.name: Gooey Thread
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon can’t retreat.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，战斗宝可梦无法撤退。

attacks.name: Poison Ring
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent’s next turn, that Pokémon can’t retreat.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于中毒状态。在对手的下个回合中，那只宝可梦无法撤退。

attacks.name: Send Flowers
attacks.desc: Search your deck for an Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched {G} Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张能量卡，附着于你的 1 只后备的 {G} 宝可梦身上。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 10 点伤害。

attacks.name: Regal Command
attacks.desc: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play.
attacks.desc_zh: 你场上每有 1 只宝可梦，此招式造成 20 点伤害。

attacks.name: Solar Coiling
attacks.desc: If Rosa’s Encouragement is in your discard pile, this attack does 150 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若「鸣依的鼓励」位于你的弃牌堆中，此招式的伤害 +150。

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，则在对手的下个回合中，防止对此宝可梦造成的所有招式伤害与效果。

attacks.name: Blow Through
attacks.desc: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 60 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若场上有竞技场卡，此招式的伤害 +60。

abilities.name: Grand Wing
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Your opponent shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If they put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, they draw 4 cards.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次此特性。对手将其手牌洗牌并放到其牌库下方。若对手以此方式将任意卡牌放到牌库下方，则对手抽 4 张牌。

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.desc: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Feather Shot
attacks.desc: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 从此宝可梦上弃置所有能量，此招式对对手的 1 只宝可梦造成 90 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不适用弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Crushing Arrow
attacks.desc: Discard an Energy from your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从对手的战斗宝可梦上弃置 1 个能量。

abilities.name: Sniper’s Eye
abilities.desc: If your opponent has exactly 4 cards in their hand, ignore all {C} Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 若对手的手牌恰好为 4 张，则忽略此宝可梦使用的招式费用中的所有 {C} 能量。

abilities.name: Sky Hunt
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random card from your opponent’s hand.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次此特性。抛硬币。若为正面，随机弃置对手的 1 张手牌。

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 张卡牌并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Dire Nails
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Burned and Poisoned. Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于灼伤和中毒状态。将此宝可梦与你的 1 只后备宝可梦交换。

attacks.name: Heat Breath
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 80 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，此招式的伤害 +80。

abilities.name: Shell Spikes
abilities.desc: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), discard an Energy from the Attacking Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 若此宝可梦位于战斗区并受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），则从进行攻击的宝可梦身上弃置 1 个能量。

abilities.name: Wash Out
abilities.desc: As often as you like during your turn, you may use this Ability. Move a {W} Energy from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以任意次数使用此特性。将 1 个 {W} 能量从你的 1 只后备宝可梦移到你的战斗宝可梦身上。

attacks.name: Jetting Blow
attacks.desc: This attack also does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式还对对手的 1 只后备宝可梦造成 50 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Nebula Beam
attacks.desc: This attack’s damage isn’t affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式的伤害不受弱点、抗性以及对手战斗宝可梦身上任何效果的影响。

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于睡眠状态。

attacks.name: Freezing Chill
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon can’t use attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，防守宝可梦无法使用招式。

abilities.name: Tundra Wall
abilities.desc: All of your Pokémon that have any {W} Energy attached take 50 less damage from attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). The effect of Tundra Wall doesn’t stack.
abilities.desc_zh: 你所有附着了 {W} 能量的宝可梦受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害减少 50 点（在计算弱点和抗性之后）。「冻原之墙」的效果不会叠加。

attacks.name: Powerful Steam
attacks.desc: Flip a coin for each {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦身上每附着 1 个 {W} 能量，抛 1 次硬币。此招式每出现 1 个正面，造成 90 点伤害。

attacks.name: Double Scratch
attacks.desc: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛 2 次硬币。此招式每出现 1 次正面就造成 10 点伤害。

abilities.name: Fighting Roar
abilities.desc: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is a Pokémon {ex}, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it.
abilities.desc_zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦是宝可梦 {ex}，则此宝可梦可以在你的首个回合或你打出它的回合进化。

attacks.name: Incessant Onslaught
attacks.desc: This attack does 70 damage for each Prize card you have taken.
attacks.desc_zh: 你每获得 1 张奖赏卡，此招式造成 70 点伤害。

attacks.name: Strong Volt
attacks.desc: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从此宝可梦身上弃置 2 个能量。

attacks.name: Follow Me
attacks.desc: Switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
attacks.desc_zh: 将对手的 1 只后备宝可梦换入战斗区。

attacks.name: Shooting Moons
attacks.desc: You may discard up to 4 Energy cards from your hand, and this attack does 40 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.
attacks.desc_zh: 你可以从手牌中弃置最多 4 张能量卡，你以此方式每弃置 1 张卡，此招式的伤害 +40。

abilities.name: Luminous Wing
abilities.desc: Prevent all effects of your opponent’s Pokémon’s Abilities done to this Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 防止对手宝可梦的特性对此宝可梦造成的所有效果。

attacks.name: Double Eater
attacks.desc: Discard up to 2 Energy cards from your hand, and this attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.
attacks.desc_zh: 从手牌中弃置最多 2 张能量卡，你以此方式每弃置 1 张卡，此招式造成 60 点伤害。

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.desc: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 回复此宝可梦的 20 点伤害。

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Confused.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于混乱状态。

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.desc: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦身上每附着 1 个能量，此招式的伤害 +30。

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.desc: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 回复你的 1 只宝可梦的 30 点伤害。

attacks.name: Draining Kiss
attacks.desc: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 回复此宝可梦的 30 点伤害。

abilities.name: Scent Collection
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for up to 2 Basic {P} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次此特性。从牌库中检索最多 2 张基本 {P} 能量卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Obliterating Nose
attacks.desc: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 从此宝可梦身上弃置 3 个能量。

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn’t happen.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，若战斗宝可梦试图使用招式，则由对手抛硬币。若为反面，则该招式不会发生。

attacks.name: Twister Spewing
attacks.desc: If you played Tarragon from your hand during this turn, discard the top 3 cards of your opponent’s deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 若你在本回合中从手牌打出了「塔拉贡」，则弃置对手牌库上方的 3 张卡。

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.desc: This attack’s damage isn’t affected by Resistance.
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式的伤害不受抗性影响。

attacks.name: Screw Knuckle
attacks.desc: Put an Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 将此宝可梦身上附着的 1 个能量加入手牌。

attacks.name: Double Draw
attacks.desc: Draw 2 cards.
attacks.desc_zh: 抽 2 张牌。

abilities.name: Stone Arms
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic {F} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your {F} Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次此特性。从手牌中把 1 张基本 {F} 能量卡附着于你的 1 只 {F} 宝可梦身上。

attacks.name: Get Angry
attacks.desc: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦身上每有 1 个伤害指示物，此招式造成 20 点伤害。

attacks.name: Vengeful Kick
attacks.desc: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 60 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若你的后备宝可梦身上放置有伤害指示物，此招式的伤害 +60。

attacks.name: Gaia Wave
attacks.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，此宝可梦受到的招式伤害 -30（计算弱点和抗性之后）。

attacks.name: Nullifying Zero
attacks.desc: For each of your opponent’s Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 150 damage to that Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的每只宝可梦各抛 1 次硬币。若为正面，此招式对该宝可梦造成 150 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不适用弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.desc: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
attacks.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为反面，此招式无效。

attacks.name: Haunt
attacks.desc: Place 3 damage counters on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 在对手的战斗宝可梦身上放置 3 个伤害指示物。

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
attacks.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦陷入中毒。

attacks.name: Hazardous Tail
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 70 damage to itself. Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦也对自己造成 70 点伤害。对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于麻痹和中毒状态。

attacks.name: Soul Destroyer
attacks.desc: Knock Out each of your opponent’s Pokémon that has 50 HP or less remaining.
attacks.desc_zh: 将对手剩余 HP 为 50 或以下的每只宝可梦击倒。

attacks.name: Dark Strike
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use Dark Strike.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用「暗黑打击」。

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.desc: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 你可以将此宝可梦与自己的 1 只后备宝可梦互换。

attacks.name: Rising Blade
attacks.desc: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is a Pokémon {ex}, this attack does 80 more damage.
attacks.desc_zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦是宝可梦 {ex}，此招式的伤害 +80。

attacks.name: Sonic Ripper
attacks.desc: Shuffle all Energy attached to this Pokémon into your deck, and this attack does 220 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 将此宝可梦身上附着的所有能量洗回你的牌库，此招式对对手的 1 只宝可梦造成 220 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不适用弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Metal Slash
attacks.desc: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
attacks.desc_zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用招式。

attacks.name: Memory Lock
attacks.desc: Choose 1 of your opponent’s Active Pokémon’s attacks. During your opponent’s next turn, that Pokémon can’t use that attack.
attacks.desc_zh: 选择对手的战斗宝可梦的 1 个招式。在对手的下个回合中，该宝可梦无法使用该招式。

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.desc: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 10 点伤害。

attacks.name: Scrape Off
attacks.desc: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
attacks.desc_zh: 在造成伤害前，弃置对手的战斗宝可梦身上的所有宝可梦道具。

attacks.name: Retaliatory Incisors
attacks.desc: This attack does 40 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Rattata.
attacks.desc_zh: 你的所有后备小拉达身上每放置 1 个伤害指示物，此招式造成 40 点伤害。

attacks.name: Tuck Tail
attacks.desc: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 将此宝可梦和其身上附着的所有卡放入你的手牌。

abilities.name: Last-Ditch Catch
abilities.desc: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can’t use more than 1 Ability that has “Last-Ditch” in its name each turn.
abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌将此宝可梦打到后备区时，你可以使用 1 次此特性。从牌库中检索 1 张支援者卡，展示并加入手牌。然后洗牌。每回合你只能使用 1 次名称中含有「绝境」的特性。

attacks.name: Gormandizer
attacks.desc: Flip a coin until you get tails. Search your deck for an amount of Basic Energy up to the number of heads and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 反复抛硬币，直到出现反面。从牌库中检索最多等于正面数量的基本能量卡，附着于此宝可梦身上。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Collapse
attacks.desc: This Pokémon is now Asleep.
attacks.desc_zh: 此宝可梦现在处于睡眠状态。

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.desc: This attack also does 30 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.desc_zh: 此招式还对你的每只后备宝可梦造成 30 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.name: Chirp
attacks.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon with {F} Resistance, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 只拥有 {F} 抗性的宝可梦，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

attacks.name: Hand Trim
attacks.desc: Discard random cards from your opponent’s hand until they have 5 cards in their hand.
attacks.desc_zh: 随机弃置对手的手牌，直到对手的手牌为 5 张。

cards.name: Roto-Stick
cards.desc: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal any number of Supporter cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 查看你牌库上方的 4 张卡。你可以展示其中任意数量的支援者卡并加入手牌。将其他卡牌洗回你的牌库。

cards.name: Hole-Digging Shovel
cards.desc: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 弃置你牌库上方的 2 张卡。

cards.name: Unfair Stamp
cards.desc:
You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent’s last turn.

Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 2 cards.
cards.desc_zh:
只有在对手的上个回合中有你的宝可梦被击倒时，你才可以使用此卡。

每位玩家将其手牌洗回其牌库。然后，你抽 5 张牌，对手抽 2 张牌。

cards.name: Enhanced Hammer
cards.desc: Discard a Special Energy from 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 从对手的 1 只宝可梦身上弃置 1 个特殊能量。

cards.name: Hyper Aroma
cards.desc: Search your deck for up to 3 Stage 1 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 3 只 1 阶进化宝可梦，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Love Ball
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Pokémon with the same name as 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon in play, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只与对手场上 1 只宝可梦同名的宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Boxed Order
cards.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Item cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. Your turn ends.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 张物品卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。你的回合结束。

cards.name: Awakening Drum
cards.desc: Draw a card for each of your Ancient Pokémon in play.
cards.desc_zh: 场上每有 1 只你的古代宝可梦，抽 1 张牌。

cards.name: Hand Trimmer
cards.desc: Each player discards cards from their hand until they have 5 cards in their hand. Your opponent discards first. (If a player has 5 or fewer cards in their hand, they do not discard.)
cards.desc_zh: 每位玩家弃置手牌，直到其手牌为 5 张。对手先弃置。（若某位玩家的手牌为 5 张或更少，则其不弃置。）

cards.name: Prime Catcher
cards.desc: Switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 将对手的 1 只后备宝可梦换入战斗区。若如此做，将你的战斗宝可梦与你的 1 只后备宝可梦交换。

cards.name: Reboot Pod
cards.desc: Attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to each of your Future Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 从你的弃牌堆中把 1 张基本能量卡附着于你的每只未来宝可梦身上。

cards.name: Ogre’s Mask
cards.desc: Choose a Pokémon {ex} in your discard pile that has “Ogerpon” in its name, and switch it with 1 of your Pokémon {ex} in play that has “Ogerpon” in its name. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 选择你弃牌堆中 1 只名称中含有「厄诡椪」的宝可梦 {ex}，并将其与场上 1 只名称中含有「厄诡椪」的你的宝可梦 {ex} 交换。附着的卡牌、伤害指示物、特殊状态、在场上的回合数以及任何其他效果都保留在新的宝可梦身上。

cards.name: Secret Box
cards.desc:
You can use this card only if you discard 3 other cards from your hand.

Search your deck for an Item card, a Pokémon Tool card, a Supporter card, and a Stadium card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh:
只有从手牌中弃置 3 张其他卡牌，你才可以使用此卡。

从牌库中检索 1 张物品卡、1 张宝可梦道具卡、1 张支援者卡和 1 张竞技场卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Scoop Up Cyclone
cards.desc: Put 1 of your Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.
cards.desc_zh: 将你的 1 只宝可梦和其附着的所有卡牌加入手牌。

cards.name: Bug Catching Set
cards.desc: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal up to 2 in any combination of {G} Pokémon and Basic {G} Energy cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 查看你牌库上方的 7 张卡。你可以展示其中最多 2 张 {G} 宝可梦卡和基本 {G} 能量卡（任意组合）并加入手牌。将其他卡牌洗回你的牌库。

cards.name: Dangerous Laser
cards.desc: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.
cards.desc_zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于灼伤和混乱状态。

cards.name: Poké Vital A
cards.desc:
Heal 150 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

This card can’t be put into your hand or deck from the discard pile.
cards.desc_zh:
回复你的 1 只宝可梦的 150 点伤害。

此卡无法从弃牌堆加入手牌或放入牌库。

cards.name: Glass Trumpet
cards.desc:
You can use this card only if you have any Tera Pokémon in play.

Choose up to 2 of your Benched {C} Pokémon and attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to each of them.
cards.desc_zh:
只有场上有你的太晶宝可梦时，你才可以使用此卡。

选择最多 2 只你的后备 {C} 宝可梦，从你的弃牌堆中把 1 张基本能量卡附着于它们各自身上。

cards.name: Antique Root Fossil
cards.desc:
Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic {C} Pokémon. This card can’t be affected by any Special Conditions and can’t retreat.

At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
cards.desc_zh:
将此卡当作 60 HP 的基础 {C} 宝可梦来打出。此卡不会受到任何特殊状态的影响，也无法撤退。

在你的回合中的任意时间，你可以将此卡从场上弃置。

abilities.name: Primal Root
abilities.desc: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent’s Basic Pokémon cost {C} more.
abilities.desc_zh: 只要此宝可梦位于战斗区，对手的基础宝可梦使用的招式费用就增加 {C}。

cards.name: Energy Search Pro
cards.desc: Search your deck for any number of Basic Energy cards of different types, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索任意数量的不同类型的基本能量卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Call Bell
cards.desc:
You can use this card only if you go second, and only during your first turn.

Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh:
只有你后攻，且仅在你的首个回合，你才可以使用此卡。

从牌库中检索 1 张支援者卡，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Meddling Memo
cards.desc: Your opponent counts the cards in their hand, shuffles those cards, and puts them on the bottom of their deck. If they do, they draw that many cards.
cards.desc_zh: 对手数出其手牌的张数，将这些卡牌洗牌并放到其牌库下方。若如此做，对手抽该数量的卡牌。

cards.name: Dragon Elixir
cards.desc: Heal 60 damage from your Active {N} Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 回复你的战斗 {N} 宝可梦的 60 点伤害。

cards.name: Deduction Kit
cards.desc: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order, or shuffle them and put them on the bottom of your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 查看你牌库上方的 3 张卡，以任意顺序放回，或将其洗牌并放到你的牌库下方。

cards.name: Scramble Switch
cards.desc: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, you may move any amount of Energy from the Pokémon you moved to your Bench to the new Active Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 将你的战斗宝可梦与你的 1 只后备宝可梦交换。若如此做，你可以将任意数量的能量从你移到后备的那只宝可梦身上移到新的战斗宝可梦身上。

cards.name: Chill Teaser Toy
cards.desc:
You can use this card only if you go second, and only during your first turn.
Put an Energy attached to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon into their hand.
cards.desc_zh:
只有你后攻，且仅在你的首个回合，你才可以使用此卡。
将对手的 1 只宝可梦身上附着的 1 个能量放入对手的手牌。

cards.name: Miracle Headset
cards.desc: Put up to 2 Supporter cards from your discard pile into your hand.
cards.desc_zh: 将你的弃牌堆中最多 2 张支援者卡加入手牌。

cards.name: Max Rod
cards.desc: Put up to 5 in any combination of Pokémon and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.
cards.desc_zh: 将你的弃牌堆中最多 5 张宝可梦卡和基本能量卡（任意组合）加入手牌。

cards.name: Treasure Tracker
cards.desc: Search your deck for up to 5 Pokémon Tool cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 5 张宝可梦道具卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Super Potion
cards.desc: Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. If you healed any damage in this way, discard an Energy from that Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 回复你的 1 只宝可梦的 60 点伤害。若你以此方式回复了伤害，则从该宝可梦身上弃置 1 个能量。

cards.name: N’s PP Up
cards.name_zh: N 的 PP 提升剂
cards.desc: Attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched N’s Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 从你的弃牌堆中把 1 张基本能量卡附着于你的 1 只后备的 N 的宝可梦身上。

cards.name: Hop’s Bag
cards.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Hop’s Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 只基础赫普的宝可梦，放到你的后备区。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Energy Switch
cards.desc: Move a Basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 将 1 个基本能量从你的 1 只宝可梦移到你的另 1 只宝可梦身上。

cards.name: Potion
cards.desc: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 回复你的 1 只宝可梦的 30 点伤害。

cards.name: Energy Retrieval
cards.desc: Put up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.
cards.desc_zh: 将你的弃牌堆中最多 2 张基本能量卡加入手牌。

cards.name: Energy Search
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Basic Energy card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张基本能量卡，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Pokégear 3.0
cards.desc: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Supporter card you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 查看你牌库上方的 7 张卡。你可以展示其中 1 张支援者卡并加入手牌。将其他卡牌洗回你的牌库。

cards.name: Pokémon Catcher
cards.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
cards.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，将对手的 1 只后备宝可梦换入战斗区。

cards.name: Master Ball
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Precious Trolley
cards.desc: Search your deck for any number of Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索任意数量的基础宝可梦，放到你的后备区。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Tera Orb
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Tera Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只太晶宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Brilliant Blender
cards.desc: Search your deck for up to 5 cards and discard them. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 5 张卡牌并将其弃置。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Sacred Ash
cards.desc: Shuffle up to 5 Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 将你的弃牌堆中最多 5 只宝可梦洗回你的牌库。

cards.name: Arven's Sandwich
cards.desc: Heal 30 damage from your Active Pokémon. If that Pokémon is an Arven’s Pokémon, heal 100 damage from it instead.
cards.desc_zh: 回复你的战斗宝可梦的 30 点伤害。若该宝可梦是派帕的宝可梦，则改为回复其 100 点伤害。

cards.name: Team Rocket's Venture Bomb
cards.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon. If tails, put 2 damage counters on your Active Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，在对手的 1 只宝可梦身上放置 2 个伤害指示物。若为反面，在你的战斗宝可梦身上放置 2 个伤害指示物。

cards.name: Team Rocket's Transceiver
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Supporter card that has “Team Rocket” in its name, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张名称中含有「火箭队」的支援者卡，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Energy Coin
cards.desc: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, search your deck for a Basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 抛 2 次硬币。若 2 次都是正面，从牌库中检索 1 张基本能量卡，附着于你的 1 只宝可梦身上。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Antique Cover Fossil
cards.desc:
Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic {C} Pokémon. This card can’t be affected by any Special Conditions and can’t retreat.

At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
cards.desc_zh:
将此卡当作 60 HP 的基础 {C} 宝可梦来打出。此卡不会受到任何特殊状态的影响，也无法撤退。

在你的回合中的任意时间，你可以将此卡从场上弃置。

abilities.name: Protective Cover
abilities.desc: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent’s Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)
abilities.desc_zh: 防止对手宝可梦使用的招式对此宝可梦造成的所有效果。（伤害不是效果。）

cards.name: Tool Scrapper
cards.desc: Choose up to 2 Pokémon Tools attached to Pokémon (yours or your opponent’s) and discard them.
cards.desc_zh: 选择最多 2 张附着于宝可梦（你的或对手的）身上的宝可梦道具并将其弃置。

cards.name: Antique Plume Fossil
cards.desc:
Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic {C} Pokémon. This card can’t be affected by any Special Conditions and can’t retreat.

At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
cards.desc_zh:
将此卡当作 60 HP 的基础 {C} 宝可梦来打出。此卡不会受到任何特殊状态的影响，也无法撤退。

在你的回合中的任意时间，你可以将此卡从场上弃置。

abilities.name: Plume Protection
abilities.desc: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon.
abilities.desc_zh: 只要此宝可梦位于你的后备区，防止对手宝可梦的招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害。

cards.name: Energy Recycler
cards.desc: Shuffle up to 5 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 将你的弃牌堆中最多 5 张基本能量卡洗回你的牌库。

cards.name: Iron Defender
cards.desc: During your opponent’s next turn, all of your {M} Pokémon take 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). (This includes new Pokémon that come into play.)
cards.desc_zh: 在对手的下个回合中，你所有的 {M} 宝可梦受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害减少 30 点（在计算弱点和抗性之后）。（这包括新上场的宝可梦。）

cards.name: Premium Power Pro
cards.desc: During this turn, attacks used by your {F} Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
cards.desc_zh: 在本回合中，你的 {F} 宝可梦使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦造成的伤害 +30（在计算弱点和抗性之前）。

cards.name: Fighting Gong
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Basic {F} Energy card or a Basic {F} Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张基本 {F} 能量卡或 1 只基础 {F} 宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Repel
cards.desc: Switch out your opponent’s Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
cards.desc_zh: 将对手的战斗宝可梦换入后备。（由对手选择新的战斗宝可梦。）

cards.name: Mega Signal
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Mega Evolution Pokémon {ex}, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只超级进化宝可梦 {ex}，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Wondrous Patch
cards.desc: Attach a Basic {P} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched {P} Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 从你的弃牌堆中把 1 张基本 {P} 能量卡附着于你的 1 只后备 {P} 宝可梦身上。

cards.name: Jumbo Ice Cream
cards.desc: Heal 80 damage from your Active Pokémon that has 3 or more Energy attached.
cards.desc_zh: 回复附着了 3 个或更多能量的你的战斗宝可梦的 80 点伤害。

cards.name: Blowtorch
cards.desc:
You can use this card only if you discard a Basic {R} Energy card from your hand.

Discard a Pokémon Tool or Special Energy card from 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon, or discard a Stadium in play.
cards.desc_zh:
只有从手牌中弃置 1 张基本 {R} 能量卡，你才可以使用此卡。

从对手的 1 只宝可梦身上弃置 1 张宝可梦道具或特殊能量卡，或弃置场上的 1 张竞技场卡。

cards.name: Energy Swatter
cards.desc: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you choose an Energy card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck.
cards.desc_zh: 对手展示其手牌，你选择其中 1 张能量卡并将其放到其牌库下方。

cards.name: Antique Jaw Fossil
cards.desc:
Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic {C} Pokémon. This card can’t be affected by any Special Conditions and can’t retreat.

At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
cards.desc_zh:
将此卡当作 60 HP 的基础 {C} 宝可梦来打出。此卡不会受到任何特殊状态的影响，也无法撤退。

在你的回合中的任意时间，你可以将此卡从场上弃置。

abilities.name: Intimidating Jaw
abilities.desc: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent’s Active Pokémon do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
abilities.desc_zh: 只要此宝可梦位于战斗区，对手的战斗宝可梦使用的招式伤害减少 30 点（在计算弱点与抗性之前）。

cards.name: Poké Pad
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Pokémon that doesn’t have a Rule Box, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (Pokémon {ex}, Pokémon {V}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只没有规则栏的宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。（宝可梦 {ex}、宝可梦 {V} 等拥有规则栏。）

cards.name: Lumiose Galette
cards.desc: Heal 20 damage and remove a Special Condition from your Active Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 回复你的战斗宝可梦的 20 点伤害，并解除其 1 个特殊状态。

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Hypnotizer
cards.desc: If the Team Rocket’s Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Team Rocket’s Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Asleep.
cards.desc_zh: 若此卡所附着的火箭队的宝可梦位于战斗区，并受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害（即使该火箭队的宝可梦被击倒），则进行攻击的宝可梦现在处于睡眠状态。

cards.name: Survival Brace
cards.desc: If the Pokémon this card is attached to has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10. Then, discard this card.
cards.desc_zh: 若此卡所附着的宝可梦 HP 全满，且将被对手宝可梦的招式伤害击倒，则它不会被击倒，其剩余 HP 变为 10。然后，弃置此卡。

cards.name: Lucky Helmet
cards.desc: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), draw 2 cards.
cards.desc_zh: 若此卡所附着的宝可梦位于战斗区，且受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），抽 2 张牌。

cards.name: Rescue Board
cards.desc: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is {C} less. If that Pokémon’s remaining HP is 30 or less, it has no Retreat Cost.
cards.desc_zh: 此卡所附着的宝可梦的撤退费用减少 {C}。若该宝可梦的剩余 HP 为 30 或更少，则它没有撤退费用。

cards.name: Maximum Belt
cards.desc: Attacks used by the Pokémon this card is attached to do 50 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon {ex} (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
cards.desc_zh: 此卡所附着的宝可梦使用的招式，对对手的战斗宝可梦{ex}造成的伤害 +50（在计算弱点与抗性之前）。

cards.name: Hero’s Cape
cards.desc: The Pokémon this card is attached to gets +100 HP.
cards.desc_zh: 此卡所附着的宝可梦的 HP +100。

cards.name: Handheld Fan
cards.desc: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), move an Energy from the Attacking Pokémon to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 若此卡所附着的宝可梦位于战斗区，且受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），从进行攻击的宝可梦上移动 1 个能量到对手的 1 只后备宝可梦上。

cards.name: Binding Mochi
cards.desc: Attacks used by the Poisoned Pokémon this card is attached to do 40 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
cards.desc_zh: 此卡所附着的处于中毒状态的宝可梦使用的招式，对对手的战斗宝可梦造成的伤害 +40（在计算弱点与抗性之前）。

cards.name: Payapa Berry
cards.desc: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s {P} Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and discard this card.
cards.desc_zh: 若此卡所附着的宝可梦受到对手 {P} 宝可梦的招式伤害，则它受到的伤害 -60（在计算弱点与抗性之后），并弃置此卡。

cards.name: Sparkling Crystal
cards.desc: When the Tera Pokémon this card is attached to uses an attack, that attack costs 1 Energy less. (The Energy can be of any type.)
cards.desc_zh: 此卡所附着的太晶宝可梦使用招式时，该招式的能量费用减少 1 个。（该能量可为任意属性。）

cards.name: Gravity Gemstone
cards.desc: As long as the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, the Retreat Cost of both Active Pokémon is {C} more.
cards.desc_zh: 只要此卡所附着的宝可梦位于战斗区，双方战斗宝可梦的撤退费用增加 {C}。

cards.name: Deluxe Bomb
cards.desc: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 12 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. If you placed any damage counters in this way, discard this card.
cards.desc_zh: 若此卡所附着的宝可梦位于战斗区，且受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），在进行攻击的宝可梦上放置 12 个伤害指示物。若你以此方式放置了伤害指示物，弃置此卡。

cards.name: Counter Gain
cards.desc: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, attacks used by the Pokémon this card is attached to cost {C} less.
cards.desc_zh: 若你的剩余奖赏卡多于对手，则此卡所附着的宝可梦使用的招式的能量费用减少 {C}。

cards.name: Haban Berry
cards.desc: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s {N} Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and discard this card.
cards.desc_zh: 若此卡所附着的宝可梦受到对手 {N} 宝可梦的招式伤害，则它受到的伤害 -60（在计算弱点与抗性之后），并弃置此卡。

cards.name: Lillie’s Pearl
cards.desc: If the Lillie’s Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card.
cards.desc_zh: 若此卡所附着的莉莉艾的宝可梦被对手宝可梦的招式伤害击倒，该玩家拿取的奖赏卡减少 1 张。

cards.name: Air Balloon
cards.desc: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is {C}{C} less.
cards.desc_zh: 此卡所附着的宝可梦的撤退费用减少 {C}{C}。

cards.name: Brave Bangle
cards.desc: If the Pokémon this card is attached to doesn’t have a Rule Box, the attacks it uses do 30 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon {ex} (before applying Weakness and Resistance). (Pokémon {ex}, Pokémon {V}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
cards.desc_zh: 若此卡所附着的宝可梦没有规则栏，则它使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦{ex}造成的伤害 +30（在计算弱点与抗性之前）。（宝可梦{ex}、宝可梦{V}等拥有规则栏。）

cards.name: Punk Helmet
cards.desc: If the {D} Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 若此卡所附着的 {D} 宝可梦位于战斗区，且受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），在进行攻击的宝可梦上放置 4 个伤害指示物。

cards.name: Sacred Charm
cards.desc: The Pokémon this card is attached to takes 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon that have an Ability (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
cards.desc_zh: 此卡所附着的宝可梦受到拥有特性的对手宝可梦的招式伤害 -30（在计算弱点与抗性之后）。

cards.name: Light Ball
cards.desc: Attacks used by the Pikachu {ex} this card is attached to do 50 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon {ex} (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
cards.desc_zh: 此卡所附着的皮卡丘{ex}使用的招式，对对手的战斗宝可梦{ex}造成的伤害 +50（在计算弱点与抗性之前）。

cards.name: Thick Scale
cards.desc: The {N} Pokémon this card is attached to takes 50 less damage from attacks from your opponent’s {G}, {R}, {W}, or {L} Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
cards.desc_zh: 此卡所附着的 {N} 宝可梦受到对手的 {G}、{R}、{W} 或 {L} 宝可梦的招式伤害 -50（在计算弱点与抗性之后）。

cards.name: Billy & O'Nare
cards.desc: Draw 2 cards. Then, if you have 10 or more cards in your hand, draw 2 more cards.
cards.desc_zh: 抽 2 张牌。然后，若你的手牌为 10 张或更多，再抽 2 张牌。

cards.name: Boss’s Orders
cards.desc: Switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
cards.desc_zh: 将对手的 1 只后备宝可梦换入战斗区。

cards.name: Perrin
cards.desc: Reveal up to 2 Pokémon in your hand and put them into your deck. If you do, search your deck for up to that many Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 展示你手牌中最多 2 只宝可梦并将其放入你的牌库。若你如此做，从牌库中检索最多与其次数相同数量的宝可梦，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Lana’s Aid
cards.desc: Put up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon that don’t have a Rule Box and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand. (Pokémon {ex}, Pokémon {V}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
cards.desc_zh: 从弃牌堆中以任意组合将最多 3 张没有规则栏的宝可梦卡和基本能量卡加入手牌。（宝可梦{ex}、宝可梦{V}等拥有规则栏。）

cards.name: Explorer’s Guidance
cards.desc: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and put 2 of them into your hand. Discard the other cards.
cards.desc_zh: 查看你牌库上方的 6 张牌，将其中 2 张加入手牌。弃置其他的牌。

cards.name: Eri
cards.desc: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you discard up to 2 Item cards you find there.
cards.desc_zh: 对手展示其手牌，你从其中弃置最多 2 张物品卡。

cards.name: Morty’s Conviction
cards.desc:
You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.

Draw a card for each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh:
仅当你从手牌中弃置另 1 张卡时，才能使用此卡。

对手每有 1 只后备宝可梦，抽 1 张牌。

cards.name: Ciphermaniac’s Codebreaking
cards.desc: Search your deck for 2 cards, shuffle your deck, then put those cards on top of it in any order.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 2 张卡，洗牌，然后以任意顺序将这些卡置于牌库上方。

cards.name: Salvatore
cards.desc: Search your deck for a card that has no Abilities and evolves from 1 of your Pokémon, and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck. You can use this card on a Pokémon you put down when you were setting up to play or on a Pokémon that was put into play this turn.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张没有特性且进化自你的 1 只宝可梦的卡，并将其放到该宝可梦上使其进化。然后洗牌。你可以对准备阶段放下的宝可梦或本回合放入场中的宝可梦使用此卡。

cards.name: Bianca’s Devotion
cards.desc: Heal all damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has 30 HP or less remaining.
cards.desc_zh: 回复你的 1 只剩余 HP 为 30 或更少的宝可梦的所有伤害。

cards.name: Carmine
cards.desc:
If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn.

Discard your hand and draw 5 cards.
cards.desc_zh:
若你先攻，你可以在你的第一个回合中使用此卡。

弃置你的手牌并抽 5 张牌。

cards.name: Hassel
cards.desc:
You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent’s last turn.

Look at the top 8 cards of your deck and put up to 3 of them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.desc_zh:
仅当你的任意宝可梦在对手的上个回合中被击倒时，才能使用此卡。

查看你牌库上方的 8 张牌，将其中最多 3 张加入手牌。将其他牌洗回你的牌库。

cards.name: Colress’s Tenacity
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Stadium card and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张竞技场卡和 1 张能量卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Janine’s Secret Art
cards.desc: Choose up to 2 of your {D} Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic {D} Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you attached Energy to your Active Pokémon in this way, it is now Poisoned.
cards.desc_zh: 选择你的最多 2 只 {D} 宝可梦。对每只该宝可梦，从牌库中检索 1 张基本 {D} 能量卡并附着于该宝可梦。然后洗牌。若你以此方式将能量附着于你的战斗宝可梦，则它现在处于中毒状态。

cards.name: Cassiopeia
cards.desc:
You can use this card only when it is the last card in your hand.

Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh:
仅当此卡是你手牌中的最后 1 张卡时，才能使用此卡。

从牌库中检索最多 2 张卡并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Xerosic’s Machinations
cards.desc: Your opponent discards cards from their hand until they have 3 cards in their hand.
cards.desc_zh: 对手从其手牌中弃置卡，直到其手牌为 3 张。

cards.name: Lacey
cards.desc: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead.
cards.desc_zh: 将你的手牌洗回你的牌库。然后，抽 4 张牌。若对手的剩余奖赏卡为 3 张或更少，则改为抽 8 张牌。

cards.name: Kofu
cards.desc: Put 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you put 2 cards on the bottom of your deck in this way, draw 4 cards. (If you can’t put 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck, you can’t use this card.)
cards.desc_zh: 以任意顺序将你手牌中的 2 张卡放到你的牌库底部。若你以此方式将 2 张卡放到了牌库底部，抽 4 张牌。（若你无法将手牌中的 2 张卡放到牌库底部，则不能使用此卡。）

cards.name: Briar
cards.desc:
You can use this card only if your opponent has exactly 2 Prize cards remaining.

During this turn, if your opponent’s Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack used by your Tera Pokémon, take 1 more Prize card.
cards.desc_zh:
仅当对手的剩余奖赏卡正好为 2 张时，才能使用此卡。

本回合中，若对手的战斗宝可梦被你的太晶宝可梦使用的招式伤害击倒，则多拿取 1 张奖赏卡。

cards.name: Drayton
cards.desc: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon and a Trainer card you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 查看你牌库上方的 7 张牌。你可以展示其中找到的 1 张宝可梦卡和 1 张训练家卡并加入手牌。将其他牌洗回你的牌库。

cards.name: Surfer
cards.desc: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.
cards.desc_zh: 将你的战斗宝可梦与你的 1 只后备宝可梦互换。若你如此做，抽牌直到你的手牌为 5 张。

cards.name: Lisia’s Appeal
cards.desc: Switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Basic Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, the new Active Pokémon is now Confused.
cards.desc_zh: 将对手的 1 只后备基础宝可梦换入战斗区。若你如此做，新的战斗宝可梦现在处于混乱状态。

cards.name: Cyrano
cards.desc: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon {ex}, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 3 只宝可梦{ex}，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Larry’s Skill
cards.desc: Discard your hand and search your deck for a Pokémon, a Supporter card, and a Basic Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 弃置你的手牌，从牌库中检索 1 只宝可梦、1 张支援者卡和 1 张基本能量卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Iris’s Fighting Spirit
cards.desc:
You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.

Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.
cards.desc_zh:
仅当你从手牌中弃置另 1 张卡时，才能使用此卡。

抽牌直到你的手牌为 6 张。

cards.name: Brock’s Scouting
cards.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon or 1 Evolution Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 只基础宝可梦或 1 只进化宝可梦，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Black Belt’s Training
cards.desc: During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do 40 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon {ex} (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
cards.desc_zh: 本回合中，你的宝可梦使用的招式，对对手的战斗宝可梦{ex}造成的伤害 +40（在计算弱点与抗性之前）。

cards.name: Cook
cards.desc: Heal 70 damage from your Active Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 回复你的战斗宝可梦的 70 点伤害。

cards.name: Judge
cards.desc: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.
cards.desc_zh: 每位玩家将手牌洗回牌库并抽 4 张牌。

cards.name: Emcee's Hype
cards.desc: Draw 2 cards. If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, draw 2 more cards.
cards.desc_zh: 抽 2 张牌。若对手的剩余奖赏卡为 3 张或更少，再抽 2 张牌。

cards.name: Ethan's Adventure
cards.desc: Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of Ethan’s Pokémon and Basic {R} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 3 张以任意组合的阿响的宝可梦卡和基本 {R} 能量卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Team Rocket's Ariana
cards.desc: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. If all of your Pokémon in play are Team Rocket’s Pokémon, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand instead.
cards.desc_zh: 抽牌直到你的手牌为 5 张。若你场上的所有宝可梦都是火箭队的宝可梦，则改为抽牌直到你的手牌为 8 张。

cards.name: Team Rocket's Archer
cards.desc:
You can use this card only if any of your Team Rocket’s Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent’s last turn.

Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards.
cards.desc_zh:
仅当你的任意火箭队的宝可梦在对手的上个回合中被击倒时，才能使用此卡。

每位玩家将手牌洗回牌库。然后，你抽 5 张牌，对手抽 3 张牌。

cards.name: Team Rocket's Giovanni
cards.desc: Switch your Active Team Rocket’s Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Team Rocket’s Pokémon. If you do, switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
cards.desc_zh: 将你的战斗火箭队的宝可梦与你的 1 只后备火箭队的宝可梦互换。若你如此做，将对手的 1 只后备宝可梦换入战斗区。

cards.name: Team Rocket's Petrel
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张训练家卡，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Team Rocket's Proton
cards.desc:
If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn.

Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Team Rocket’s Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh:
若你先攻，你可以在你的第一个回合中使用此卡。

从牌库中检索最多 3 只基础火箭队的宝可梦，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: N's Plan
cards.desc: Move up to 2 Energy from your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 从你的后备宝可梦移动最多 2 个能量到你的战斗宝可梦上。

cards.name: Fennel
cards.desc: Heal 40 damage from each of your Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 回复你的每只宝可梦的 40 点伤害。

cards.name: Harlequin
cards.desc: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, flip a coin. If heads, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards. If tails, you draw 3 cards, and your opponent draws 5 cards.
cards.desc_zh: 每位玩家将手牌洗回牌库。然后，抛硬币。若为正面，你抽 5 张牌，对手抽 3 张牌。若为反面，你抽 3 张牌，对手抽 5 张牌。

cards.name: Cheren
cards.desc: Draw 3 cards.
cards.desc_zh: 抽 3 张牌。

cards.name: Hilda
cards.desc: Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只进化宝可梦和 1 张能量卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Lt. Surge's Bargain
cards.desc: Ask your opponent if each player may take a Prize card. If yes, each player takes a Prize card. If no, you draw 4 cards.
cards.desc_zh: 询问对手是否双方各拿取 1 张奖赏卡。若是，双方各拿取 1 张奖赏卡。若否，你抽 4 张牌。

cards.name: Lillie's Determination
cards.desc: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. If you have exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead.
cards.desc_zh: 将你的手牌洗回你的牌库。然后，抽 6 张牌。若你的剩余奖赏卡正好为 6 张，则改为抽 8 张牌。

cards.name: Acerola's Mischief
cards.desc:
You can use this card only if your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining.

Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play. During your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to that Pokémon by your opponent’s Pokémon {ex}.
cards.desc_zh:
仅当对手的剩余奖赏卡为 2 张或更少时，才能使用此卡。

选择你场上的 1 只宝可梦。在对手的下个回合中，防止对手的宝可梦{ex}的招式对该宝可梦造成的所有伤害和效果。

cards.name: Wally's Compassion
cards.desc: Heal all damage from 1 of your Mega Evolution Pokémon {ex}. If you healed any damage in this way, put all Energy attached to that Pokémon into your hand.
cards.desc_zh: 回复你的 1 只超级进化宝可梦{ex}的所有伤害。若你以此方式回复了伤害，将该宝可梦上附着的所有能量加入你的手牌。

cards.name: Grimsley's Move
cards.desc: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck and put a {D} Pokémon you find there onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards and put them on the bottom of your deck. You can’t use this card during your first turn.
cards.desc_zh: 查看你牌库上方的 7 张牌，将其中找到的 1 只 {D} 宝可梦放到你的后备区。将其他牌洗牌并放到你的牌库底部。你不能在你的第一个回合中使用此卡。

cards.name: Dawn
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, a Stage 1 Pokémon, and a Stage 2 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只基础宝可梦、1 只 1 阶进化宝可梦和 1 只 2 阶进化宝可梦，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Firebreather
cards.desc: Search your deck for up to 7 Basic {R} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 从牌库中检索最多 7 张基本 {R} 能量卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Canari
cards.desc:
You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.

Search your deck for up to 4 {L} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh:
仅当你从手牌中弃置另 1 张卡时，才能使用此卡。

从牌库中检索最多 4 只 {L} 宝可梦，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Waitress
cards.desc: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach a Basic Energy card you find there to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.desc_zh: 查看你牌库上方的 6 张牌，将其中找到的 1 张基本能量卡附着于你的 1 只宝可梦。将其他牌洗回你的牌库。

cards.name: Urbain
cards.desc: Draw 3 cards.
cards.desc_zh: 抽 3 张牌。

cards.name: Tarragon
cards.desc: Put up to 4 in any combination of {F} Pokémon and Basic {F} Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.
cards.desc_zh: 从弃牌堆中以任意组合将最多 4 张 {F} 宝可梦卡和基本 {F} 能量卡加入手牌。

cards.name: Rosa's Encouragement
cards.desc:
You can use this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.

Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Stage 2 Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh:
仅当你的剩余奖赏卡多于对手时，才能使用此卡。

从你的弃牌堆中将最多 2 张基本能量卡附着于你的 1 只 2 阶进化宝可梦。

cards.name: Jacinthe
cards.desc: Heal 150 damage from 1 of your {P} Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 回复你的 1 只 {P} 宝可梦的 150 点伤害。

cards.name: Community Center
cards.desc: Once during each player’s turn, if they played a Supporter card from their hand this turn, they may heal 10 damage from each of their Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 每位玩家的回合中，若该玩家本回合从手牌中使用了支援者卡，则可以使用 1 次，回复其每只宝可梦的 10 点伤害。

cards.name: Perilous Jungle
cards.desc: During Pokémon Checkup, put 2 more damage counters on each Poisoned non-{D} Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s).
cards.desc_zh: 在宝可梦检查时，在每只中毒的非 {D} 宝可梦（双方的）上多放置 2 个伤害指示物。

cards.name: Full Metal Lab
cards.desc: {M} Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s) take 30 less damage from attacks from the opponent’s Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
cards.desc_zh: {M} 宝可梦（双方的）受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害 -30（在计算弱点与抗性之后）。

cards.name: Festival Grounds
cards.desc: Each Pokémon that has any Energy attached (both yours and your opponent’s) recovers from all Special Conditions and can’t be affected by any Special Conditions.
cards.desc_zh: 所有附着有能量的宝可梦（双方的）从所有特殊状态中恢复，且不会受到任何特殊状态的影响。

cards.name: Jamming Tower
cards.desc: Pokémon Tools attached to each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s) have no effect.
cards.desc_zh: 附着于每只宝可梦（双方的）的宝可梦道具没有效果。

cards.name: Neutralization Zone
cards.desc:
Prevent all damage done to Pokémon that don’t have a Rule Box (both yours and your opponent’s) by attacks from the opponent’s Pokémon {ex} and Pokémon {V}. (Pokémon {ex}, Pokémon {V}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

This card can’t be put into your hand or deck from the discard pile.
cards.desc_zh:
防止对手的宝可梦{ex}和宝可梦{V}的招式对没有规则栏的宝可梦（双方的）造成的所有伤害。（宝可梦{ex}、宝可梦{V}等拥有规则栏。）

此卡不能从弃牌堆被放入你的手牌或牌库。

cards.name: Academy at Night
cards.desc: Once during each player’s turn, that player may put a card from their hand on top of their deck.
cards.desc_zh: 每位玩家的回合中，该玩家可以使用 1 次，将手牌中的 1 张卡放到其牌库上方。

cards.name: Grand Tree
cards.desc: Once during each player’s turn, that player may search their deck for a Stage 1 Pokémon that evolves from 1 of their Basic Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. If that Pokémon was evolved in this way, that player may search their deck for a Stage 2 Pokémon that evolves from that Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, that player shuffles their deck. (Players can’t evolve a Basic Pokémon during their first turn or a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn.)
cards.desc_zh: 每位玩家的回合中，该玩家可以使用 1 次，从牌库中检索 1 只进化自其 1 只基础宝可梦的 1 阶进化宝可梦，并将其放到该宝可梦上使其进化。若该宝可梦以此方式进化，该玩家可以从牌库中检索 1 只进化自该宝可梦的 2 阶进化宝可梦，并将其放到该宝可梦上使其进化。然后，该玩家洗牌。（玩家不能在其第一个回合中进化基础宝可梦，也不能进化本回合放入场中的基础宝可梦。）

cards.name: Area Zero Underdepths
cards.desc:
Each player who has any Tera Pokémon in play can have up to 8 Pokémon on their Bench.

If a player no longer has any Tera Pokémon in play, that player discards Pokémon from their Bench until they have 5. When this card leaves play, both players discard Pokémon from their Bench until they have 5, and the player who played this card discards first.
cards.desc_zh:
场上有太晶宝可梦的每位玩家，其后备区最多可有 8 只宝可梦。

若某位玩家场上不再有太晶宝可梦，该玩家从其后备区弃置宝可梦直到其剩余 5 只。当此卡离场时，双方玩家都从其后备区弃置宝可梦直到其剩余 5 只，且放置此卡的玩家先弃置。

cards.name: Lively Stadium
cards.desc: Each Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent’s) gets +30 HP.
cards.desc_zh: 场上的每只基础宝可梦（双方的）HP +30。

cards.name: Gravity Mountain
cards.desc: Each Stage 2 Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent’s) gets -30 HP.
cards.desc_zh: 场上的每只 2 阶进化宝可梦（双方的）HP -30。

cards.name: N’s Castle
cards.desc: N’s Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent’s) have no Retreat Cost.
cards.desc_zh: 场上的 N 的宝可梦（双方的）没有撤退费用。

cards.name: Levincia
cards.desc: Once during each player’s turn, that player may put up to 2 Basic {L} Energy cards from their discard pile into their hand.
cards.desc_zh: 每位玩家的回合中，该玩家可以使用 1 次，从弃牌堆中将最多 2 张基本 {L} 能量卡加入手牌。

cards.name: Postwick
cards.desc: Attacks used by Hop’s Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s) do 30 more damage to the opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
cards.desc_zh: 赫普的宝可梦（双方的）使用的招式，对对手的战斗宝可梦造成的伤害 +30（在计算弱点与抗性之前）。

cards.name: Team Rocket's Watchtower
cards.desc: {C} Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent’s) have no Abilities.
cards.desc_zh: 场上的 {C} 宝可梦（双方的）没有特性。

cards.name: Team Rocket's Factory
cards.desc: Once during each player’s turn, if they played a Supporter card that has "Team Rocket" in its name from their hand this turn, they may draw 2 cards.
cards.desc_zh: 每位玩家的回合中，若该玩家本回合从手牌中使用了名称中含有「火箭队」的支援者卡，则可以使用 1 次，抽 2 张牌。

cards.name: Granite Cave
cards.desc: Steven’s Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s) take 30 less damage from attacks from the opponent’s Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
cards.desc_zh: 大吾的宝可梦（双方的）受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害 -30（在计算弱点与抗性之后）。

cards.name: Spikemuth Gym
cards.desc: Once during each player’s turn, that player may search their deck for a Marnie’s Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into their hand. Then, that player shuffles their deck.
cards.desc_zh: 每位玩家的回合中，该玩家可以使用 1 次，从牌库中检索 1 只玛俐的宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后，该玩家洗牌。

cards.name: Risky Ruins
cards.desc: Whenever any player puts a Basic non-{D} Pokémon onto their Bench during their turn, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 每当任一玩家在其回合中将基础的非 {D} 宝可梦放到其后备区时，在该宝可梦上放置 2 个伤害指示物。

cards.name: Forest of Vitality
cards.desc: Each player’s {G} Pokémon can evolve into {G} Pokémon during the turn they play those Pokémon, except during their first turn.
cards.desc_zh: 每位玩家的 {G} 宝可梦可以在其使用这些宝可梦的回合中进化为 {G} 宝可梦，但其第一个回合除外。

cards.name: Surfing Beach
cards.desc: Once during each player’s turn, that player may switch their Active {W} Pokémon with 1 of their Benched {W} Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh: 每位玩家的回合中，该玩家可以使用 1 次，将其战斗 {W} 宝可梦与自己的 1 只后备 {W} 宝可梦互换。

cards.name: Mystery Garden
cards.desc: Once during each player’s turn, that player may discard an Energy card from their hand in order to draw cards until they have as many cards in their hand as they have {P} Pokémon in play.
cards.desc_zh: 每位玩家的回合中，该玩家可以使用 1 次，从手牌中弃置 1 张能量卡，以抽牌直到其手牌张数等于其场上 {P} 宝可梦的数量。

cards.name: Battle Cage
cards.desc: Prevent all damage counters from being placed on Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s) by effects of attacks and Abilities from the opponent’s Pokémon. (Damage from attacks is still taken.)
cards.desc_zh: 防止对手宝可梦的招式和特性的效果在后备宝可梦（双方的）上放置伤害指示物。（招式的伤害仍会承受。）

cards.name: Dizzying Valley
cards.desc: Confused Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s) don’t recover from that Special Condition when they evolve or devolve.
cards.desc_zh: 处于混乱状态的宝可梦（双方的）在进化或退化时不会从该特殊状态中恢复。

cards.name: Nighttime Mine
cards.desc: Attacks used by each Tera Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent’s) cost {C} more.
cards.desc_zh: 场上的每只太晶宝可梦（双方的）使用的招式的能量费用增加 {C}。

cards.name: Lumiose City
cards.desc: Once during each player’s turn, that player may search their deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto their Bench. Then, that player shuffles their deck. If a player searches their deck in this way, their turn ends.
cards.desc_zh: 每位玩家的回合中，该玩家可以使用 1 次，从牌库中检索 1 只基础宝可梦并将其放到其后备区。然后，该玩家洗牌。若某位玩家以此方式检索了牌库，其回合结束。
